title: Product Marketing Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at hyperexponential
description_html:
Hi 👋 I'm Chris. I'm a Lead Product Marketing Manager at hx - I joined over four years ago as a Product Marketing Manager. Outside of work you'll find me playing sport (badly), watching reality TV, or taking my dog Lucky to the park (or the pub!).

Product Marketing at hx is a highly strategic function. We shape the company's positioning and messaging, decide where and when products launch, and build the process that gets them to market.

This role comes with deep ownership over how we address our core audience: actuaries. You’ll need to go deep into the life and workflow of highly technical users and develop messaging, positioning, and content that neatly conveys the benefits of our solution.

You'll need to be comfortable managing senior stakeholders and have great taste - but what matters most is drive, and a willingness to solve problems as you find them. In return, you'll join a team that's kind, supportive, and full of very smart people who want to go fast and far. If that sounds like you, read on!

About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a £7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-pound decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the team

Marketing at hx operates at the intersection of demand generation, systems thinking, and constrained markets. We build authority and demand in a highly technical, niche space where every account matters. This isn't template-driven volume work - it's deep, strategic B2B marketing crafted for a known universe of accounts, and we stay involved from first engagement through to customer success.

As Product Marketing Manager for Calculation Engines and Portfolio Intelligence, you'll sit at the heart of how hx becomes the obvious choice for actuaries who want to price faster and steer their portfolio with confidence. You'll own the technical story for our developer community - the most demanding audience we serve - and be the connective tissue between Product, Revenue, and the AI team, turning user insight into sharp positioning, useful sales assets, and narratives that stand up to scrutiny from people who'll know immediately if they don't. Your work spans two distinct challenges at once: deepening engagement and value realisation for our established Calculation Engines product, whilst driving launch readiness, early adoption, and strong feedback loops for Portfolio Intelligence.

The team experiments constantly, uses AI to focus on strategy over busy work, and operates with a high bar for quality and pace. You'll be joining a group that takes work seriously but not themselves, where compressed learning is the norm and the most future-ready in your craft is the standard.

Check out our Marketing & GTM Engineering Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining!

What you'll be doing

Drive deeper engagement and adoption of Calculation Engines among existing users, using the usage data we now have to spot where users stall and creating messaging and enablement that moves them forward.

Own go-to-market execution for the Portfolio Intelligence release end to end - positioning, launch materials, enablement, and user communications that get it in front of the right people and drive real usage.

Accelerate early adoption of Portfolio Intelligence by creating onboarding support and launch assets that help target users get to first value quickly, evidenced by users moving out of the beta programme into sustained use.

Become the developer community's champion by writing technical content at a regular cadence that Solutions Engineering uses in live deals, and answering architecture and integration questions directly rather than routing them to Product.

Build hx's position in actuarial AI by developing differentiated positioning and up-to-date competitive understanding that works consistently across website copy, enablement, and customer conversations.

Establish strong feedback loops between users, Product, Revenue, and the AI team, so insight from launches, testing, and field conversations directly informs messaging, prioritisation, and product direction.

What you'll need to have done

Led product marketing in a B2B SaaS environment, balancing adoption work for an existing product with launch readiness for a new one at the same time - demonstrating commercial judgement across multiple GTM motions.

Increased engagement or adoption of a mature product by using user insight to sharpen messaging or enablement - with measurable improvement in usage, understanding, or qualitative feedback from users and revenue teams.

Owned a product launch end to end, including the internal readiness and enablement work that happens before it ships - not just the moment it goes out.

Turned a complex technical capability into credible, differentiated messaging for a skeptical, technical audience - developers or an equivalent evaluator population - built on real user insight rather than generic claims.

Worked hands-on alongside a Solutions Engineer or equivalent technical partner, comfortable being challenged on technical detail and holding your line, and earning trust across Product, Engineering, and Revenue without relying on formal authority.

Used AI with real judgement about when a technical claim is actually true rather than just plausible, and applied that judgement to rebuild how systems like enablement, competitive intelligence, or win/loss work - not just run them faster.

You're unlikely to thrive here if

  • You expect full product maturity, clear roadmaps, and well-defined processes before taking action - hx moves fast and requires comfort operating in ambiguity where products, priorities, and messaging are still evolving.

  • You focus primarily on flashy launch work or brand campaigns rather than the detail-oriented, outcomes-driven work of deepening adoption, engagement, and user understanding.

  • You struggle to prioritise or make trade-offs without perfect information, waiting for others to decide rather than using judgment to move work forward with the context available.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your Talent Partner will be able to share more details about this.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  1. Talent Screening (30 minutes)

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (60 minutes)

  3. Skills Assessment & Panel (45 minutes)

  4. Values Interview (60 minutes)

  5. Meet the CEO/CPO/VP Eng (40 minutes)

  6. We offer!

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

title: Sales Development Representative

description_html:
Job Description:

About Us

Nylon is rebuilding how professional advice gets made. Not built for accountants and lawyers — built with them.

We work alongside firms that cannot afford to be wrong. They expect precision, speed and an answer they can put their name to, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our platform turns tax and accounting research that used to take hours into minutes, and powers the end-to-end workflow around it.

We are firmly established in the UK, working with tax and accounting firms across the country, with clients across professional services in Australia and New Zealand and partnerships with the professional bodies our prospects already belong to. We are now opening the United States.

Joining Nylon means three things.

  • We move first: high agency over waiting for permission, outcomes over intentions.

  • We hold the bar: direct, ego-free feedback and standards that do not slip when it is busy.

  • We learn out loud: what you work out on the phone today, the whole team uses tomorrow.

Small team. Real ownership. No passengers.

If you are driven by pace, mastery, and being early to something that is about to get very big — this is the place.

What You'll Do

  • Own the phone. Cold call decision-makers at professional services firms and book qualified meetings for our sales team.

  • Open a new market. Work a UK-led patch that now includes early-stage outreach into the US — all inside a normal Brighton working day.

  • Run a tight rhythm. Call blocks, follow-ups and clean pipeline hygiene, executed the same way every day.

  • Learn the product properly. Our products are new and genuinely complex; knowing how firms actually get value from them is the job, not a nice-to-have.

  • Sharpen the message. Learn our ICP and messaging fast, then make both better through iteration and feedback.

  • Research like an analyst. Use trusted sources to understand prospects, personalise outreach and lift conversion.

  • Feed the machine. Share what you hear on calls so we can tighten targeting and positioning.

What You Bring

  • Extreme motivation to master selling. You want to be the best in the world at this, and you are prepared for what that takes.

  • High agency. You find the way through rather than waiting to be told.

  • A strong verbal game. Clear, concise, human — and comfortable being the first voice a partner hears that week.

  • Resilience. No does not slow you down.

  • Pace. We move fast, so you learn and adapt fast.

  • Coachability. You take direct feedback and apply it the same day.

Your academic background is not essential. What you can demonstrate is.

What's In It For You

  • Warm ground to work from. An established UK client base and professional body partnerships that put our name in front of your prospects before you call them.

  • A market to open, not just a patch to work. You will help build something from nothing rather than maintaining what is already there.

  • Front-row seat to the AI shift in professional services. You will be selling the change, not reading about it.

  • World-class training. Structured onboarding and ongoing coaching on our own AI systems and modern B2B SaaS sales methods.

  • Commission earned on qualified meetings attended.

  • Peer recognition scheme and corporate discounts.

  • An in-person environment. A Brighton office built for people who want to be in the room.

Nylon is an equal opportunity employer

Great teams are built on a range of thought and experience. We welcome people of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Work Location: Brighton, occasionally London

Own marketing at an AI legal research company that already has 1,900+ firms as customers.

Nylon is an AI-native tax and legal research platform used by 1,900+ accountancy and law firms across the UK, Australia and New Zealand. We were the first product accredited by ICAEW in the Legal Information and Research Software category, and we hold an ACCA affiliation. The UK business has been built almost entirely on outbound sales. It works, and it has taken us a long way. Now we want a second engine, and you would be the person who builds it.

This is our first dedicated marketing hire in the UK. There is no team beneath you yet and no playbook to inherit. There is a working sales motion, a product accountants and lawyers actually use, strong accreditation credentials, and a founder-led company that moves quickly. You will set the marketing strategy and then do most of the work yourself.

What you'll own

  • Pipeline. SEO and content, paid search and LinkedIn, email nurture, webinars and free-trial campaigns. Your number is qualified pipeline handed to our SDR and AE team, and you will be measured on it.

  • Brand and content. Sharpen how Nylon shows up in the UK accountancy and legal market: website, thought leadership, case studies, PR and awards, and the marketing side of our ICAEW and ACCA relationships.

  • Product marketing. Own the messaging. Turn what the product does into language that lands with a tax partner or a managing partner, keep our positioning against incumbent research providers sharp, and equip the sales team with battlecards, decks and one-pagers.

  • Events and community. Get us in front of the right people: ICAEW and ACCA events, industry conferences, our own roundtables and customer community. Some travel within the UK.

  • Measurement. Set up attribution and reporting in our CRM (Attio) so we know what is working, and kill what is not.

What we're looking for

  • 5–8 years in B2B marketing, with at least a few of those in SaaS or a subscription product, ideally selling to professional services (accountancy, legal, financial services).

  • You have built something from little or nothing before: a demand-gen function, a content programme, a launch. You are comfortable being the strategist and the person executing at 4pm on a Thursday.

  • Fluent in the tools: SEO and analytics, paid search and paid social, marketing automation and CRM, and the AI tools that make a small team punch above its weight.

  • You write well. Clearly, quickly, without fluff. Most of what marketing produces is words, and ours need to be credible to accountants and lawyers.

  • Commercially minded. You care about pipeline and revenue, not vanity metrics, and you enjoy working shoulder to shoulder with a sales team.

  • Curious about AI and about how professional services firms are changing. You do not need a legal or tax background, but you need to be able to learn the market fast.

Nice to have: experience marketing to accountants or lawyers; familiarity with ICAEW, ACCA or Law Society ecosystems; hands-on experience with webinar programmes or partnership marketing.

What we offer

  • £55,000–£70,000 base, depending on experience

  • Real ownership: you set the strategy, you get the budget, you build the team as we grow

  • A product customers rely on daily and a market that is being reshaped by AI right now

  • A small, fast, international team across the UK, Australia and New Zealand

Please send a CV and, instead of a cover letter, one page on how you would generate qualified pipeline for Nylon in your first 90 days.

Nylon is the trading name of Law Cyborg Limited. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from everyone. You must have the right to work in the UK.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at incident.io
description_html:
A little about us

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Netflix, Etsy, and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $96 million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

A little about us

incident.io is the leading AI incident response platform, relied on by some of the best engineering teams in the world when things go wrong.

Since launching in 2021, we've helped over 2,000 companies, including OpenAI, Netflix, and Airbnb, run more than 1 million incidents.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for.

We like to have fun and we never take ourselves too seriously. We've raised $96 million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

As an Enterprise AE at incident, you sell to the engineering leaders who cannot afford to get incidents wrong, and every deal you close is one more company that handles its worst day better.

What that looks like day to day

As an Enterprise AE at incident, you're selling into the biggest and most complex accounts we go after, the ones where an incident going badly becomes a board-level problem. Intercom, Etsy, Miro, HashiCorp and StubHub are already customers, so you're not cold-starting a story nobody believes. The product has real market fit and it is nowhere near fully capitalised. That gap is the whole opportunity.

The team you're joining are seasoned sellers who are as much strategic partners and product evangelists as they are closers. Enterprise cycles here mean six or seven decision-makers, technical buyers who will test you properly, and C-level conversations where you need to be credible immediately. You'll run demos alongside SE's, and the feedback you bring back goes to a product team that ships in hours and days, not quarters.

Sales isn't a function bolted onto the side of this business, it's central to how we win. You'll work with leadership on building sales process rather than inheriting a finished one, and challenging how we do things is the job itself, not something you get credit for on top.

We're AI-forward, founded by engineers, and everyone here has unlimited Claude access. We expect you to use it properly: researching accounts, prepping deals, and moving faster than the rep across the table at a legacy vendor.

Who you are

  • You've closed $100k+ new business at the top end of enterprise, and you can talk me through how you actually did it, not just what the number was.

  • You're comfortable in a room full of engineers and CTOs. Technical buyers don't faze you, and you know the difference between selling to them and selling at them.

  • You're a proper hunter. You've got more than one way into an account, and a run of rejection doesn't take the wind out of you.

  • You build the case with evidence. Data, the right customer story, real product knowledge, whatever it takes to move that particular stakeholder.

  • Multi-threading is instinct, not technique. You assume there are six people on the other side of the deal and you'd rather know all of them.

  • You've got opinions about the product and you share them. The best reps here are the ones product actually listens to.

  • Startup ambiguity suits you. The playbook is half-written, nobody is going to hand you a process, and you'd rather help build one.

  • You're good to work with. You'll be close to leadership, SEs and CSMs, and you care about being someone people want in the room.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

  • Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover - we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

  • Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

  • First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

  • Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

  • Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

  • Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

  • Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

  • Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

Compensation: £95K – £120K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission

  • London • £95K – £120K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission

title: Channel Sales Manager

description_html:
About Artemis

Artemis is building the future of AI-driven defense – helping companies detect and defend themselves effectively in an era where AI is fighting AI on the cyber battlefield.

We’re backed by First Round Capital, Brightmind, and a group of the cybersecurity industry’s most prominent Operators.

Our founders, Shachar (ex-Palo Alto Networks, AWS, Demisto) and Dan (ex-Abnormal Security, Twitter) have previously built, launched, and scaled cybersecurity products loved and trusted by tens of thousands of customers, and have the customer, technology, and security know-hows to deliver this vision.

Our exceptionally strong team includes software engineers, AI researchers, security engineers, and product designers hailing from Google, Abnormal AI, Wiz, Meta, AWS, CERN, SentinelOne, and more.

We are growing our team and looking for passionate builders to join us and support our expanding customer base.

The Role

As our first EMEA Channel Sales Manager, you'll own building Artemis's indirect go-to-market motion in the UK and Europe. You'll identify, recruit, and enable strategic partners (Distributors Value Added Resellers, MSSP’s and GSI’s) to sell Artemis into new and existing customer base. You'll develop partner programs, provide enablement and support, manage partner relationships, and ensure partners are generating pipeline and closing deals.

This role is critical to scaling beyond direct sales. You'll have autonomy to shape our channel strategy, build partner relationships from scratch, and drive significant revenue through indirect channels.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and recruit strategic channel partners (Distributors, Value Added Resellers, MSSP’s and GSI’s) across the UK and Europe

  • Develop and manage partnership agreements, pricing structures, and incentive programs

  • Onboard new partners and provide initial enablement (product training, positioning, sales tools, technical certification)

  • Build partner success playbooks—what works, what messaging lands, how to close deals

  • Conduct regular business reviews with partners to monitor pipeline, revenue, and performance

  • Support partner sales teams on complex deals (technical questions, customer introductions, deal strategy)

  • Co-market with partners (joint webinars, events, case studies, campaigns)

  • Manage partner portal, training materials, and go-to-market resources

  • Build forecasting models around partner revenue and pipeline

  • Identify gaps in partner coverage and recruit to fill them

  • Collaborate with Sales, Product, and Customer Success to ensure smooth handoffs and partner success

  • Hit revenue targets tied to partner-sourced deals and pipeline

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in channel sales, partner sales, or indirect go-to-market roles in B2B technology or cybersecurity

  • Proven track record building channel programs from scratch or scaling existing programs

  • Strong understanding of partner types (Distributors, Value Added Resellers, MSSP’s and GSI’s) and how to recruit, enable, and manage them

  • Experience managing multiple partners simultaneously and hitting revenue targets

  • Deep network in the UK/European cybersecurity or enterprise technology space (or ability to build one quickly)

  • Comfortable negotiating partnerships, pricing, and incentive structures

  • Strong presentation and communication skills—you'll train partners and present to leadership

  • Project management skills—you'll own multiple workstreams and timelines

  • CRM and sales ops experience (Salesforce, Pipedrive, or similar)

  • Ability to balance structure with flexibility—partners need support, but you can't hand-hold forever

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and building processes from scratch

Nice to Have

  • Prior channel/partner experience (you've seen how they buy and what they want)

  • Cybersecurity or security product expertise

  • Experience building MDF (Marketing Development Funds) or partner incentive programs

  • Regional presence and relationships in UK/Europe

  • Experience at early-stage SaaS companies scaling go-to-market

We’re backed by First Round Capital, Brightmind, and a group of the cybersecurity industry’s most prominent Operators.

Our founders, Shachar (ex-Palo Alto Networks, AWS, Demisto) and Dan (ex-Abnormal Security, Twitter) have previously built, launched, and scaled cybersecurity products loved and trusted by tens of thousands of customers, and have the customer, technology, and security know-hows to deliver this vision.

Our exceptionally strong team includes software engineers, AI researchers, security engineers, and product designers hailing from Google, Abnormal AI, Wiz, Meta, AWS, CERN, SentinelOne, and more.

We are growing our team and looking for passionate builders to join us and support our expanding customer base.

Job Overview

We're looking for a Security Research Engineer to drive detection research, threat hunting, and AI-powered security automation. You'll work at the intersection of security expertise and cutting-edge AI—researching data sources, building detections, investigating real incidents, and engaging directly with customers to deliver security value. This is a hands-on, high-impact role where your work directly shapes what threats we catch and how we catch them.

Responsibilities

  • Develop AI-powered detection tooling - Build automation that leverages AI to accelerate detection creation, tuning, and validation at scale.

  • Conduct security research - Analyze cloud, identity, and SaaS data sources (AWS CloudTrail, Okta, Entra ID, and more) to extract security value and identify detection opportunities.

  • Perform attack simulations - Execute authorized attack simulations to validate detection coverage and identify gaps in our defenses.

  • Hunt for threats - Proactively search for malicious activity across customer environments using our platform and tooling.

  • Investigate potential cases - Analyze security incidents to demonstrate product value, refine detection logic, and deliver actionable findings.

  • Engage with customers - Join customer calls to present analysis results, walk through findings, and gather feedback that shapes the product.

  • Tune customer detections - Reduce false positives and improve detection accuracy based on real-world data and customer context.

  • Build investigation automation - Create AI-powered tools that scale investigation and threat hunting workflows across our platform.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of hands-on cybersecurity experience

  • Hands-on experience in incident response including cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and identity providers (Okta, Entra ID)

  • Strong knowledge of threat actor tactics, techniques, & procedures and demonstrated understanding uncovering threat actor activity in various environments

  • Strong experience with log-based analysis and demonstrated ability to identify malicious activity across a variety of log sources

  • Ability to translate security research into actionable detections or threat hunt investigations

  • Strong communication skills—comfortable explaining technical findings to engineers and customers

  • Experience with detection engineering at scale

  • Bonus:

    • Background working in a SOC environment or Managed Detection and Response.

    • Familiarity with a wide range of security tools (SIEM, EDR, SOAR)

    • Customer-facing technical experience

    • Experience with AI tools and models

Why Work at Artemis?

  • Make a real world impact. Help empower cybersecurity teams around the world to keep people safe from the most advanced cyber threats.

  • Be challenged to be better than ever before. Our team includes some of the smartest and most driven people in the world. We guarantee you will learn more in 1 year here than 10 years in another place.

  • Push the boundaries of technology. Work with and build the most advanced AI capabilities in the world of cybersecurity, including cutting-edge analytics and agentic platforms. Your ideas will shape the product and the industry.

  • Innovative culture. We obsess about customers, move fast with high quality, and value open communication, mentorship and learning. You will have autonomy to drive projects and support to grow.If you are passionate about building resilient distributed systems and want to apply your expertise to defend against AI‑powered adversaries, we’d love to hear from you.

    If you are passionate about cybersecurity and want to apply your expertise to build AI-powered defenses against advanced threats, we'd love to hear from you.

Compensation
We offer a competitive compensation of 160,000$- 190,000$ per year, and a top-of-market equity component. A variety of factors are considered when determining the compensation, including a candidate’s professional experience. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed.

Equal Opportunity
At Artemis, we believe the best ideas come from diverse teams. We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can do their best work. We welcome everyone, regardless of race, gender, age, religion, identity, or anything else that makes you, you.

title: Senior Graphic Designer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Bumble Inc.
description_html:
Bumble’s Creative Studio is an exciting inflection point, supporting Bumble Inc.’s portfolio of apps globally. We’re looking to hire a Senior Graphic Designer to be an integral part of our growing team, working on global projects and across time zones.

In this lead role within the Creative Studio, you’ll be responsible for developing effective, exciting, and culturally relevant work for our portfolio of brands. You’ll be part of a full-service, in-house, geographically diverse creative team of designers, art directors, and copywriters who work hand-in-hand with video editors and a global network of producers and external production partners. 

The Senior Graphic Designer is a highly skilled and versatile designer who brings both craft and conceptual thinking to every project. With a strong command of design across print, digital, social and campaign work, they can move seamlessly between briefs, maintaining a consistently high standard of output. They are confident working autonomously as well as collaboratively, bringing proactive energy and fresh ideas to the team.

Your creative scope will span a wide variety of communications, from global campaigns and social content to cultural brand moments and marketing initiatives, in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. 

This role is based in the U.K. reporting to the Design Lead in London.

What You'll Do

  • Designing across a broad range of communications for Bumble Inc.'s diverse brands; spanning print, digital, social, growth, marketing, and campaign work globally.

  • Taking ownership of complex briefs from concept through to execution, delivering high-quality design work that is on-brand and consistently excellent.

  • Collaborating closely with copywriters, motion designers, art directors and other creatives to produce cohesive, compelling work across all brands.

  • Contributing actively in brainstorming and concepting sessions, bringing strong creative ideas and a point of view to the table.

  • Presenting work to key stakeholders, clearly articulating design decisions and how they ladder up to the brief and brand objectives.

  • Upholding and championing Bumble Inc.'s brand standards across all markets and touchpoints, ensuring consistency at every level.

  • Manage your own workload effectively, and flag any resource or timeline considerations.

  • Collaborating with cross-functional partners across marketing and product to help translate briefs into compelling creative solutions, ensuring brand consistency at every touchpoint.

  • Staying ahead of design trends, cultural moments, and industry best practices; bringing fresh thinking and relevant references into your work.

Experience We Are Looking For

  • The ideal candidate will have a strong portfolio that demonstrates exceptional craft and versatile design thinking across multiple channels, from brand campaigns and social content to digital and print. They'll have a track record of delivering high volumes of high-quality work in a fast-paced environment, with the confidence and experience to take full ownership of projects from brief to final delivery.

  • They're a self-starter who brings energy and ideas to every brief, works comfortably without close supervision, and thrives as part of a collaborative, geographically diverse creative team. While this is an individual contributor role, they'll naturally set a high bar through the quality of their work and the thoughtfulness of their creative contributions.

About You

  • A bachelor’s degree in a related field

  • 7+ years of experience in design roles, preferably in the tech sector

  • You have an expert command of design applications (Adobe CC, Figma), using the latest design tools, and embracing the future

  • You have a robust portfolio of work that demonstrates strong design thinking and exceptional craft

  • across print, digital, social and campaign channels.

  • You are positive and committed with a 'can-do' attitude and a flexible approach to complex problems, using this to problem solve into elegant and accessible designs.

  • You’re comfortable working autonomously (delivering design) and in collaboration with others (discovering a solution)

  • You have great communication skills, both verbal and written, and are confident presenting and

  • explaining your creative decisions to stakeholders.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple briefs and meeting tight deadlines without compromising on quality.

  • You have excellent time management skills, strong organisational skills and great attention to detail, ensuring our work always communicates clearly and is on brand.

  • You possess a strong understanding of design principles including typography, layout, and colour theory.

  • You can comfortably deliver work across both print and digital platforms.

  • You showcase conceptual thinking and creative problem-solving abilities.

  • You have an understanding of content management systems for asset tracking and creation.

  • You are passionate about our brand vision and values.

About Us

Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products.

AI Fluency

AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes.

We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews. We care deeply about authenticity and want to understand your real skills, judgment and voice, because building a meaningful, genuine connection with you matters to us.

Final Compensation

Will be determined based on factors such as the selected candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, skill set, and other job-related considerations.

Inclusion at Bumble Inc.

Bumble Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and we strongly encourage people of all ages, color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, people with disabilities, and neurodivergent people to apply. We're happy to make any reasonable adjustments that will help you feel more confident throughout the process, please don't hesitate to let us know how we can help.

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example: she/her, he/him, they/them, etc).

AI in Bumble Inc. Hiring

At Bumble, we may use AI tools to support parts of our recruitment process — such as helping us record, transcribe, and summarize conversations, and supporting job alignment by comparing resumes and job descriptions to highlight skills and potential roles that may be a good match. These tools help us work more efficiently and stay focused on you during our conversations. Importantly, all hiring decisions are made by people. AI is used only to support our team’s efficiency and improve the candidate experience — not to evaluate or decide on your candidacy. Participation in AI-supported interviews and conversations is completely voluntary and will not impact your candidacy. If you’d prefer to opt out, simply let your recruiter or interviewer know at the start of a call, or anytime during the interview or conversation. Summaries and related data are retained only as long as needed in line with our internal data retention policies. If at any point you’d like a transcription or summary deleted, please contact your recruiter directly.

Fraudulent Candidate Detection

Our applicant tracking system analyzes signals relating to device, IP, email, and phone data associated with each application to protect applicants and our hiring process from fraudulent applications. These signals provide indicators for internal review only and do not constitute a definitive determination of identity or intent. No applicant is rejected, advanced, or otherwise affected based solely on this analysis without human review

For further information on how we hold and manage your data, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

title: Machine Learning Engineer (UK)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Bumble Inc.
description_html:
Machine Learning Engineer — Matching & Recommendations

At Bumble, we’re building the Love Company — a place where healthy, equitable relationships and friendships can start and grow. Machine Learning plays an important role in that mission, powering the matching, recommendation and personalisation experiences that help our members discover meaningful connections.

As a Machine Learning Engineer, Matching & Recommendations, you’ll work hands-on to develop and improve the ML systems behind these experiences. You’ll own well-defined ML problems end-to-end — from exploring data and developing models through experimentation, deployment and monitoring — while learning from experienced engineers and contributing to the evolution of Bumble’s recommendation platform. This is an opportunity to apply modern ML techniques to real-world problems at scale and see the direct impact of your work on our members.

What you'll be doing

  • Explore, develop and deliver modern Machine Learning solutions that improve recommendations, matching and personalisation across Bumble.

  • Own defined ML problems end-to-end, from data exploration and feature engineering through model training, evaluation, production deployment and iteration.

  • Use modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow to design, train and optimise models for production environments.

  • Contribute to experimentation, including A/B testing and offline evaluation, using results to continuously improve model and product performance.

  • Build, maintain and monitor production models, diagnosing issues and improving reliability and performance at scale.

  • Write high-quality, maintainable code and contribute to code reviews, technical discussions and engineering best practices.

  • Take ownership of delivering high-quality solutions from insight through to measurable impact, balancing speed, quality and technical rigour.

  • Apply responsible AI practices, considering fairness, transparency, privacy and member safety throughout model development and deployment.

  • Collaborate with Machine Learning, Engineering, Product and Data partners to translate member and product problems into practical ML solutions.

We'd love to meet someone with

  • Around 3+ years of hands-on experience building and shipping Machine Learning models in production, although we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds who demonstrate equivalent skills and experience.

  • Strong programming skills in Python and proficiency with an ML framework such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.

  • Industry experience researching or applying Machine Learning, ideally in areas such as recommendation systems, ranking, retrieval, search or personalisation.

  • Good understanding of the ML development lifecycle, including data and feature development, training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring and iteration.

  • Understanding of MLOps and infrastructure concepts such as CI/CD for ML, feature stores, model serving, observability and versioning.

  • Familiarity with containerisation and cloud-native environments such as Docker, Kubernetes and GCP, or comparable technologies.

  • Familiarity with experimentation methodologies, including A/B testing, offline evaluation and model performance metrics.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently navigate defined but technically ambiguous problems.

  • An agile mindset, adapting your approach based on data, experimentation and evolving priorities whilst maintaining focus on outcomes.

  • Growing AI fluency, with the ability to independently apply ML techniques and emerging technologies, including LLMs where appropriate, responsibly and effectively.

An added bonus if you have

  • Practical experience building recommendation systems, ranking, retrieval, search or personalisation systems in production.

  • Experience with modern recommendation approaches such as embeddings, two-tower models, learning-to-rank or representation learning.

  • Exposure to modern ML architectures and techniques such as transformers, graph neural networks, contrastive learning or multimodal embeddings.

  • Experience working with real-time or low-latency ML inference systems at scale.

About Us

Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Python
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Nelly Solutions
description_html:
We’re on the lookout for an ambitious Senior Software Engineer with focus on Python to join our Engineering team at our office in Berlin. Join us in building the largest AI enabled fintech for healthcare!

About Nelly

We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people.

Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality.

What sets us apart: We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI isn't a nice-to-have at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable.

Joining us, you will:

  • Build and maintain our Python backend using FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLModel/SQLAlchemy, and PostgreSQL (including pgvector), designing the APIs and data models that power the platform

  • Contribute across the stack when needed, working with our TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Node.js applications

  • Build AI-powered workflows using modern language models, orchestration frameworks, and evaluation tooling

  • Take ownership from development to production by building, deploying, and operating services on AWS with infrastructure managed through Terraform

  • Collaborate closely with product, design, and data to ship impactful, user-centric features

  • See your ideas go from concept to implementation, impacting customers within your first few days

  • Make a significant contribution to defining, maintaining and improving our architecture and best practices

  • Join a driven, highly skilled, engineering team and collaborate with talented professionals - learning from their expertise and contributing your own

What you'll bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering

  • Strong proficiency in Python, ideally with a modern web framework like FastAPI (or Django/Flask)

  • Experience with data and API modeling (e.g., Pydantic, SQL/ORMs) and relational databases like PostgreSQL

  • Experience with cloud platforms like AWS and infrastructure as code (Terraform a plus)

  • Bonus: hands-on experience building with LLMs / AI agents in production

  • Knowledge of software engineering best practices for the full development life cycle

  • A pragmatic mindset and strong sense of ownership

  • Team player attitude with excellent communication skills

What we offer:

  • Deutschlandticket (public transport pass covering all of Germany) or Swapfiets membership, so you get around the city fast

  • Urban Sports Club membership, for sport and balance

  • Flexible working hours and a hybrid setup

  • Up to 4 weeks of workation

  • A dog-friendly office with great vibes and a team that's fun to work with

  • Snacks and a fridge full of cold drinks

We welcome applications from people of all genders and backgrounds, regardless of origin or age. If you're convinced you're the right fit for this role - even if your CV doesn't match the requirements 100% - tell us why.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Software Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Nelly Solutions
description_html:
We are looking for a Forward Deployed Software Engineer to help us solve complex workflow problems directly at the edge of our business: where product, engineering, commercial teams and customers meet.

What to expect in the role as Forward Deployed Software Engineer:

This isn't classic product engineering, nor pure implementation. You'll work alongside our Commercial teams and customers to find operational bottlenecks, then build pragmatic, high-quality software end to end: AI-powered workflows, internal tools, customer-specific automations, data migrations, dashboards and integrations that strip manual work out of onboarding and customer success.

Your role competency will sit in Engineering: we care deeply about technical quality, maintainability, security and ownership. Your business accountability will sit close to Commercial: your success will be measured by how much you unblock customers, reduce manual work and help Nelly scale faster.

 

About Nelly

We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people.

Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality.

What sets us apart: We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI isn't a nice-to-have at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable.

Joining us, you will:

  • Work closely with Commercial, Product and Engineering to identify high-impact customer and workflow problems

  • Build end-to-end solutions using TypeScript, React, AWS and modern AI/LLM tooling

  • Own the problem from discovery to production: clarify the problem, design the solution, implement it, ship it, monitor it and improve it

  • Be close to the customers: join customer conversations to understand workflows, validate assumptions, and translate real-world complexity into technical solutions

  • Operate in ambiguous environments where there is no perfect spec, no perfectly prepared ticket and no one handing you a step-by-step plan

  • Collaborate with Engineering to ensure your solutions meet our standards for reliability, security, observability and maintainability

What you'll bring:

  • Several years as a software engineer, ideally from a startup or similarly fast, broad environment where you've worn many hats and owned things end to end - from understanding the user problem to shipping production-ready software

  • Strong experience with TypeScript and React, and being comfortable working across the stack, including APIs and cloud infrastructure (ideally AWS)

  • Hands-on experience building AI/LLM-based workflows and excitement about using them to solve practical business problems

  • Strong curiosity about customer workflows and the ability to quickly understand operational complexity, even with ambiguity and incomplete information

  • Pragmatism and strong product judgment: you know when to build something robust, when to automate, when to simplify, when not to over-engineer - and how to prioritise by business impact

  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Fluency in German and English

What we offer:

  • Deutschlandticket (public transport pass covering all of Germany) or Swapfiets membership, so you get around the city fast

  • Urban Sports Club membership, for sport and balance

  • Flexible working hours and a hybrid setup

  • Up to 4 weeks of workation

  • A dog-friendly office with great vibes and a team that's fun to work with

  • Snacks and a fridge full of cold drinks

We welcome applications from people of all genders and backgrounds, regardless of origin or age. If you're convinced you're the right fit for this role - even if your CV doesn't match the requirements 100% - tell us why.

title: Growth Marketing | Intern / Working Student (d/f/m)
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Luminovo GmbH
description_html:
🚀 YOUR OPPORTUNITY

Want real hands-on experience in B2B SaaS marketing — running webinars, shaping demand gen campaigns, and building the AI-powered systems that run our marketing team? Then it's an exciting time to join Luminovo!

We help electronics manufacturers and OEMs manage one of the most complex supply chains in the world by bringing sourcing, quoting, and procurement into a single, modern platform. As we scale, our marketing team needs more hands to keep webinars, campaigns, and content moving — and that's where you come in.

Here's what makes this opportunity different: we run "AI by default", and we're one of the first marketing teams making tools like Claude a daily habit, not a nice-to-have. You'll spend real time watching how the team works, spotting the recurring manual tasks, and building the automations and workflows that remove them. Nowhere else will you get this kind of head start on how AI is about to reshape marketing work.

We're hiring for this role in two flavors — pick whichever matches your situation:

  • Working student: 20h/week, ongoing

  • Intern: 3–6 months, full-time (with the option to convert to a permanent role)

Both cover the same scope and both start 01 September 2026, based hybrid out of our Munich office.

You won't be doing busywork. You'll cut the webinar clips that actually get watched, build the campaign assets that go live, help ship the case studies our sales team uses to close deals, and build the AI workflows that free up the whole team's time. You'll work directly with 7 people across the whole marketing team — so in a few months you'll have touched more of B2B SaaS marketing (and modern AI tooling) than most internships give you in a year.

If you're hungry, a fast learner, and want real mentorship instead of coffee runs, we'd love to hear from you!

👥 WHOM YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH

  • Mark, Head of Marketing

  • Isabela, Senior Content Engineer & Strategist

  • George, Demand Generation Lead

  • Cindy, Senior Product Marketing Manager

  • Iva, Senior Revenue Operations Manager (Marketing Ops)

  • Chris, Website Developer & Designer

  • Julie, Brand & Content Designer

  • Performance marketing agency

🎯 PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES

  • 🤖 AI & automation: observe the team's recurring, manual tasks and propose what's worth automating; build and ship real automations, workflows, and Claude skills and plugins the team actually uses; document and roll out new AI tooling once it works.

  • 🎙 Webinars & content: cut short clips from webinar recordings for LinkedIn, build Canva assets from existing templates, create CMS/on-demand entries for finished webinars, draft per-event email copy (invites, reminders, follow-ups) for review, draft social recap posts, and handle scheduling across the webinar calendar.

  • 📈 Field marketing & demand gen: campaign and list admin, processing event attendee lists, translation checks on ad assets (German), reporting & analytics support, and event prospect sourcing.

  • 🎨 Product marketing: supporting case studies and customer stories, producing sales enablement assets, product launch support, competitive research legwork, and keeping CMS entries updated and quality-checked.

💬 LANGUAGE REQUIREMENTS

Fluency in German and English is a must. Our webinar program tilts US/UK, so your English needs to be excellent — German is needed for the DACH content stream and recap posts.

💡 SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE, AND EXPERTISE

We purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. What matters most: you're currently studying (or recently graduated), curious about B2B/SaaS marketing, tech, and AI, and organized enough to juggle small recurring tasks across different stakeholders. No webinar or automation experience required — this is fully trainable, and being excited to get hands-on with tools like Claude, Canva, and our CMS Framer is a big plus. If you're interested in why we banned requirements from our job descriptions – see here: https://luminovo.com/resources/blog/why-we-banned-requirements-from-our-job-descriptions

⚡️ About Luminovo

Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry.

We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress.

We bring innovations to life faster and cheaper by creating a more connected and resilient electronics supply chain.

To date, over 300 active customers worldwide are working with us towards this shared goal. Supported by leading investors such as Cherry Ventures, General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million.

Our core principles: putting people first & building great things

As a remote-first company headquartered in Munich, our brilliant team is spread across cities including Munich, New York, Austin, Calgary, Berlin, London, Valencia, Nairobi, and Verona, among others. 🌍

Our team includes a mix of product enthusiasts, people advocates, business masterminds, and engineering experts. Among us are graduates from institutions like Stanford University and the University of Cambridge, as well as talented individuals with unconventional CVs. What matters most is their drive to build great things.

We provide an authentic environment based on psychological safety to empower Luminerds from various backgrounds to succeed, grow, and focus on impact. Putting people first means that we deeply care about who our employees are, what makes them unique, and what they excel at.

See what employees and candidates have to say about Luminovo on kununu and Glassdoor.

 

Compensation: €1,392 – €3,150 per month • Multiple Ranges

  • Level 0.1 • Base Salary €1,392 – €2,650 per month
  • Level 0.2 • Base Salary €1,566 – €2,900 per month
  • Level 0.3 • Base Salary €1,740 – €3,150 per month

salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Omaze
description_html:
Omaze is reinventing fundraising by offering people the chance to win once-in-a-lifetime prizes while raising millions for charities around the world. Since launching in the UK in 2020, we've become one of the fastest-growing companies in the country and now, we’re scaling our impact across Europe.

title: Entrepreneur in Residence (m/w/d) - Healthcare Sector - Rollup

description_html:
Founded in 2025, Taxforce rethinks tax advisory from the ground up: AI-powered and highly automated, yet personal. We start with the ambulatory healthcare sector, a complex and underserved segment, with the ambition to expand into many more sectors over time. Tax advisory is a €40B market in Germany alone, with processes that have barely changed in decades. AI is now enabling a fundamental shift and there are no playbooks yet. We're writing them.

We are a small, highly ambitious team in Berlin, backed by €5M from Tenet VC and founded by alumni of Goldman Sachs, Harvard Business School, Bain & Company, and the former Klarna Head of Engineering.



About the role

As Entrepreneur in Residence for the healthcare sector in our tax rollup, you will be responsible for Taxforce's core vertical, the medical sector. You will be building the best-in-class tax advisory product for the ambulatory healthcare sector and owning the business behind it. At the core, this is a product role: you'll take the pain points and needs of doctors and MVZ operators and turn them into a systematic, scalable product, built in close collaboration with our tax ops and tech teams. As the vertical matures, you'll take full ownership of the unit, including sales, P&L, and partnerships, and grow into the leader who scales it into a standalone business.

This role is built for someone who has founded a company before, or who wants to one day. You'll get founder-level scope and responsibility from day one, with the backing of an experienced team.

What you'll do

  • Define what a best-in-class tax advisory experience looks like for the ambulatory healthcare sector by converting the needs and pain points of doctors and MVZ operators into a systematic, scalable tax advisory product

  • Execute the product vision in close collaboration with our tax ops and tech teams, building AI-powered workflows that differentiate Taxforce from traditional advisors

  • Oversee sales for the medical vertical and own the P&L, accountable for revenue and margin targets

  • Build and manage partnerships with MVZ operators, medical roll-ups, and key referral networks to drive inbound deal flow

  • Acquire and build design customers as the foundation for developing and validating the vertical's strategy

  • As the unit grows, take on leadership of the entire vertical, building and leading a dedicated team across product, GTM, and operations

  • Report directly to the founders and contribute to company-wide strategy

Who you are

  • You've founded a company before, or you're building toward founding your own one day, and you want founder-level ownership now

  • You can translate messy, real-world customer problems into a clear, scalable product

  • You're comfortable owning commercial outcomes: sales, P&L, partnerships, not just the product itself

  • Ideally, you have existing relationships or credibility within medical practices, MVZ, or the healthcare procurement world

  • You want to lead. You're energized by the idea of building and eventually running a full business unit, not just contributing to one

What we offer

  • Gain entrepreneurial experience: build a company within a company, with full ownership of product, sales, and P&L

  • Work with the founders: direct access to a team with Goldman Sachs, HBS, Bain, and Klarna backgrounds

  • AI at the core: see how AI transforms a traditional industry, and actively shape the product

  • Steep learning curve: real problems, fast feedback, and the experience to lead, or start, your own venture

About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank group, we are adding a layer of resources and expertise to benefit from, while continuing to operate as an independent fintech company with our own team, product, and start-up identity under the dwpbank umbrella.

Your Mission:

As a Founder’s Associate Intern, you will support the leadership team here at lemon.markets, making sure the business grows and runs smoothly, ensuring alignment across all business areas.

You will work with different teams on a selection of diverse projects, ranging from Strategy and Operations to BizDev and GTM and more. These projects can be hard to forecast and will highly depend on needs evolving from the phase lemon.markets is in, as well as hugely on your interests and the skill set you already bring along or want to learn.

You will get the best of both worlds: Experience first-hand how a start-up is being built, enjoy and benefit from a fast-paced and flexible environment, while working closely with experienced experts in their field. That means you will not only support and leverage your skill set, but learn and grow by taking on projects with a high degree of ownership.

You will:

  • Support our leadership team on strategic projects by helping develop and execute business strategies and ensuring alignment with our company goals and objectives.

  • Help define and develop our GTM strategy by researching market trends, analysing competitors and their activities, and staying up to date with the evolving brokerage landscape in Europe.

  • Drive strategic initiatives across teams as we scale our business operations and strengthen the partner experience post launch.

  • Critically assess, analyse, and improve existing processes, helping us build scalable processes that enable the organisation to run smoothly and support our continued growth.

Who are you:

  • You have a background in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Computer science or a related field.

  • You are an entrepreneurial and analytical problem solver who combines structured and critical thinking with a high degree of ownership and independence.

  • You have gained hands-on experience in a fast-paced environment. You understand what working in an early-stage startup looks like. Alternatively, you have worked in consulting, venture capital, tech or similar roles before.

  • You take ownership, identify problems proactively, challenge the status quo, and manage ambiguity and changing priorities effectively.

  • You have a hands-on and iterative mindset: you act quickly, learn from first results, and continuously improve your work across changing tasks and requirements.

  • You are a collaborative team player who enjoys sharing knowledge and learning new tools and skills.

  • You are fluent or a native German speaker (this is a mandatory requirement). You also have strong written and verbal English skills.

How we take care of you:

  • 🚀 Compensation package: Our Interns are compensated at a fixed rate of €2,425 per month.

  • 💎 Make a real impact: Our start-up environment gives you the opportunity to start your career, explore areas outside your role, and build expertise through ownership. As we mature and are backed by dwpbank, we’re adding additional resources and expertise that you can benefit from.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9-to-5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

title: Product Marketing Manager (Robotics & Automation)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at RobCo
description_html:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

The Role

RobCo goes to market across three streams: Alfie (our emerging, headline-making Physical AI product), Embedded Robotics, and Integrated Solutions. This role owns product marketing for the latter two — together the backbone of RobCo's current business. Embedded Robotics is our single largest source of net-new revenue today; Integrated Solutions is our large-deal, high-touch offering, often but not exclusively delivered together with partners.

This is a depth role. You'll get genuinely close to customers and verticals - automotive, food & beverage, electronics, plastics, and more - and turn that understanding into the content and enablement material that helps Sales (and our partners) actually close. RobCo already has a growing library of real deployments with measurable results; a large part of this role is turning that raw material into whitepapers, case studies, and video content people actually use.

Longer term, you'll help lay the groundwork for RobCoMMUNITY - the network of engaged customers and champions we're building across Embedded and Integrated. Finding and nurturing the customers willing to go public with their story is as much a part of this role as writing the story itself.

Your Responsibilities

1. Sales Enablement for Embedded Robotics & Integrated Solutions

  • Own enablement materials — pitch decks, battlecards, objection handling — for both streams.

  • Integrated Solutions skews heavily toward partner-led deals — build materials that equip our partner network, not just our direct sellers.

2. Customer & Vertical Understanding

  • Build and maintain vertical-specific messaging and use-case libraries — automotive, food & beverage, electronics, plastics, and beyond.

  • Talk regularly to customers, Sales, and Solutions Engineering so messaging stays grounded in what's actually being deployed, not just what's on the roadmap.

3. Content Creation, at Volume

  • Own whitepapers, case studies, and video content end-to-end — turning real deployments into content Sales can actually use in a deal.

  • Keep the case study and reference library current as new proof points land — this is a living library, not a one-time project.

4. RobCoMMUNITY (Long-Term)

  • Help lay the groundwork for RobCoMMUNITY across our customer landscape.

  • Identify and nurture reference customers willing to go public - case studies, testimonials, events.

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

  • 3–5 years in Product Marketing, Content Marketing, or Customer Marketing - B2B; industrial or technical experience is a strong plus.

  • Strong, proven writing skills - comfortable owning a whitepaper or case study from a rough customer conversation through to a finished, polished piece.

  • Genuine curiosity about customers - comfortable interviewing a customer and turning their story into content that sells.

  • Organized to keep a growing content library current - this role is as much about maintenance as creation.

  • Fluent in English; German is a strong plus.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in industrial, manufacturing, robotics, or adjacent B2B tech.

  • Experience supporting sales motions.

  • Video content coordination experience.

  • Familiarity with content workflows.

Why Join RobCo

The category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics is being defined right now, and our partner ecosystem is one of the key levers for how we scale across Europe and into the US. As the first person in this function, you will have a rare combination of strategic ownership and direct impact - building something from scratch that will matter at company scale.

  • Own a function end-to-end from day one, with direct access to senior leadership

  • Work at the intersection of Marketing, Sales, and Partnerships in a company at a category-defining moment

  • Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and - depending on the role - the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events - from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. You'll sit at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing - with a named Product counterpart and a standing seat at roadmap and design reviews.

  • Real fluency in robotics, automation, mechatronics, industrial hardware/software systems, or AI - gained on the job, not just in a classroom.

  • Experience owning content production end-to-end - from briefing creative partners and managing a campaign calendar to taking projects from concept through to finished content.

  • Experience with RaaS, SaaS, or hardware-software business models.

  • Completed vocational training or a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Physics, or comparable experience.

  • Several years of experience in reliability engineering focused on complex electro/mechanical products.

  • Strong ownership and growth mindset, pragmatic working style and analytical rigor to reach defensible conclusions from incomplete evidence.

  • Very good English skills (German is a plus).

  • Practical command of RBD modeling, MTBF/MTTF prediction, L10/B10 life calculation, and hands-on FMEA/FMEDA experience.

The Role

As our first Senior Partner Marketing Manager, you will build the partner marketing function from scratch - co-defining the strategy with our VP of Marketing and owning the execution end-to-end. This is not a role where you hand off to someone else to implement. You design it, you build it, and you run it. If you need someone else to execute for you, this is not the right role.   • Co-develop and continuously refine RobCo's global partner marketing strategy together with the VP of Marketing and our Global Partner Director aligned with the partner tier structure owned by the Partner Management team

  • Translate the overall partner strategy into a concrete, executable marketing plan with clear milestones and KPIs

  • Build the infrastructure for partner marketing from the ground up: processes, templates, tracking mechanisms, and reporting frameworks

  • Own the tracking of all partner marketing activities and their contribution to pipeline and revenue

  • Develop partner marketing guidelines that ensure consistent positioning and messaging in line with RobCo's category leadership in Autonomous Industrial Robotics

  • Equip partners with the materials they need to go to market effectively on RobCo's behalf

  • Build strong working relationships directly with partner contacts, including partners who work exclusively in German

  • Experience with co-marketing, joint campaigns, and partner enablement materials

  • A genuine interest in AI and how it applies to your own work - we actively use AI tools to move faster and expect our team to do the same

  • Bonus: familiarity with the industrial automation, robotics, or Physical AI space

Why Join RobCo
