description_html:
About Cortea

We’re Cortea, a Berlin startup transforming audits with AI. Manual, document-heavy audits waste expert time while demand keeps rising. Our AI-powered software and specialized AI agents remove the repetitive work so auditors can focus on judgment.

Backed by top-tier VCs with >15m funding, with a working product and paying customers, we’re rapidly scaling.

We value first-principles thinking, speed, trust, and kindness. We build side by side in our Berlin office.

The Role

You build talent foundations. You’ll design a process, that bring in exceptional talent across Tech and Non-Tech, and build a culture we’re proud of.

What you’ll do

  • Own the Talent end to end: job design → scope → JD → sourcing → structured interviews → offer → close

  • Build a Talent Engine: attract great people proactively; both inbound and outbound

  • Raise the hiring bar: scorecards, trained interviewers, consistent candidate experience

  • Shape our brand for Tech/AI talent with content, events, and a strong referral loop

  • Be culture-positive: partner with founders on rituals, onboarding handover, and feedback loops

You’ll be great at this if you

  • Have 5+ years of TA in a fast environment (startup/scale-up or agency)

  • Have hired top talent before and know the difference in how to assess them

  • Communicate clearly, leverage our founding team, and make data driven decisions fast

  • Can show early-stage track record you’re proud of

  • Think in systems and improve with data; bonus if you’ve built employer branding for engineers/AI

How we work

  • We value kindness + candor + execution, speed with care, and strong ownership

  • We’re fully in-office in Berlin because we like building side by side

  • We hire with structured interviews and clear scorecards to reduce bias

  • Non-linear paths welcome. Career breaks welcome. If you’re unsure, apply.

What we offer

  • High impact from day one and a path to Head of Talent/People as we grow

  • Competitive salary + meaningful equity (range shared on the first call)

  • In-office energy. shared lunches, whiteboard time, fast decisions, real teamwork

  • Uncapped growth. Budget for tools, learning, and events you choose

Interview process

  • Intro Call (25 min) with Liza

  • Expert interview (45 min): with Valentin (Co-Founder) - deep dive into: sourcing strategy, process design, quality in decisions)

  • Cultural interview (45 min): with Philipp (Co-Founder) - collaboration, judgment, and culture add

  • On-site day (Berlin): meet the team and work on a real life assignment

About us

We’re Cortea, a Berlin-based startup rebuilding how audits are done.

Audits are still driven by spreadsheets, checklists, and manual reviews in one of the most regulated, high-stakes areas of business. We use AI to automate audits end to end, so highly educated auditors no longer spend 60+ hour weeks on manual work and can focus on judgment, trust, and choices that matter.

With €15m+ in funding, a live product, and paying customers across Europe, we’re at a stage where your choices will directly shape Cortea’s future, and how audits are done.

 

The role

This isn't an administrative or "assistant" role. As Chief of Staff, you are a core member of the leadership orbit. You will work directly with Valentin (Co-Founder) to translate high-level vision into operational reality.

You will sit at the intersection of Growth, Strategy, Finance, and Operations. Your mission is to tackle the most complex, ambiguous challenges that don’t yet have a home, whether that’s architecting our international expansion, refining our AI-driven unit economics, or managing the machinery of a Series B fundraise.

This role is a springboard. You will gain a "CEO-level" view of building a category-defining AI company.

 

What you’ll do

  • Strategic Initiatives: Lead high-impact projects from conception to completion (e.g., designing an AI-era pricing model, spearheading entry into new European markets, or optimizing the sales-to-onboarding funnel).

  • Fundraising & IR: Act as the primary engine behind investor relations and future funding rounds, preparing the narratives and data rooms that will fuel Cortea’s growth.

  • Scaling the AI-Native Operating System: Build the repeatable processes, meeting cadences, and communication loops — supercharged with AI agents and automation — that allow Cortea to scale toward €100m+ ARR without losing speed. You'll treat internal workflows as products, deploying AI wherever it removes friction.

  • Founder Force Multiplier: Act as a proxy for the founders in internal and external meetings, ensuring decisions are made and projects stay on track even when the founders aren't in the room.

     

Who you are

  • 4+ years of experience in high-velocity environments (Top-tier Strategy Consulting, Investment Banking, or a high-growth VC-backed startup).

  • Strategic Operator: You can think at 30,000 feet about market positioning, but you have the grit to dive into a spreadsheet or a legal contract to get a deal over the line.

  • Financial Fluency: You have a deep understanding of P&L management, financial modeling, and SaaS metrics.

  • Exceptional Communicator: You can distill complex AI concepts and financial data into clear, persuasive narratives for investors and the team.

  • High Agency: You don’t wait for a playbook; you write it. You are comfortable with the ambiguity of a "zero-to-one" environment.

  • Language: Native or professional fluency in both English and German (C1+) is essential for this Berlin-based role.

 

How we work

  • Founder mindset: Everyone acts like a founder. You’re encouraged to take on any topic you believe is worth improving, with team and founder support.

  • Thoughtful decision-making: Collaborative problem solving, concise written thinking, and deep in-person discussions to reach the best result.

  • Speed over perfection: We value progress and learning, preferring strong 80/20 solutions over perfection.

  • Feedback & learning: We give and ask for feedback weekly. Not monthly.

 

What success looks like

  • In 3 months: You have worked through our ops, deployed workflow automations across the company, and offloaded 20% of the founders' highest-priority tasks.

  • In 6 months: You have led at least one major cross-functional launch (e.g., a new country or a major pricing pivot) and are the go-to person for our lead investors.

  • In 12 months: You have helped institutionalize the "Cortea Way," creating a scalable operational foundation that supports our next major funding milestone.

 

What we offer

  • Impact: A seat at the table during the most critical growth phase of a well-funded AI startup.

  • Growth: Mentorship from experienced founders and close collaboration across the company

  • Compensation: Competitive salary + meaningful equity.

  • Perks: Learning budget, team lunches, off-sites, flexible vacation, and a supportive in-office setup in central Berlin

     

Interview process

  • Intro call with Liza (Founders Associate)

  • Strategy & finance interview, real-world scenario with Valentin (Co-Founder)

  • Culture interview, Values and Collaboration Fit with Philipp (Co-Founder)

  • On-site day (Berlin): meet the team and work through a real, current problem

We’re an equal‑opportunity team and strongly encourage women and underrepresented candidates to apply.

description_html:
Build something that truly matters

At Cortea, we envision a world where every audit is proactively managed by humans and AI agents collaboratively. Where auditing professionals have superhuman capabilities at their fingertips to strengthen the trust in the world's most critical systems.

We're not just improving auditing workflows, we're redefining how audits are done from the ground up. With a rapidly growing, global customer base and backing from world-class investors, the market is ready. What we ship next decides how big this gets.

This is your chance to join a team of sharp, ambitious and kind builders extremely early. Shape the company at its pivotal moment and build something that truly matters.

About the role

At Cortea, design earns trust, and we sell to an industry that exists to produce it. Auditors are paid to be skeptical, and people judge quality by what they can see: the product, the website, the deck a partner opens in a boardroom, the newsletter someone reads with their first coffee. All of it is Cortea.

This is a role for someone with great taste in designing software and AI systems. You'll find novel patterns for problems that haven't existed in software before, and you'll own how Cortea looks and feels to the outside world.

Roughly 70% product, 30% brand. The product work is deep, expert-facing and systems-heavy. As we are doubling down on design, you'll be working on taking the core flows to the next level. The brand work is yours to own outright: website, marketing and sales visuals, newsletter, event and content assets. It'll be on screen in a Big4 boardroom, in every customer's inbox, and on the wall at the events we host. A lot of surface for one designer, and all of it yours.

We're not looking for someone to ask whether the logo goes left or right. We're looking for someone with opinions.

What you'll do

  • Work directly with our founders, engineers, and customers to turn audit flows into intuitive, delightful interfaces

  • Work with Jonas on product design and design strategy overall

  • Own our brand designs and visuals

  • Evolve our visual identity and design system

  • Take increasing ownership of brand direction. Website, marketing and sales material, content and event assets

  • Help shape the product vision, roadmap, and user experience standards

  • Run usability tests, build user feedback loops, and bring a systems mindset to design decisions

You'll be great at this if you

  • Have product design experience in B2B / SaaS, ideally in fast-moving startups.

  • Think in experiences, not screens. With taste you can defend. Product and brand are one surface; you can explain why details work, and you call out when they don’t.

  • Want to create a unique brand, which auditors love. Identify, marketing, web should be a draw, not a tax. Taste and passion matter more than volume.

  • Can hold complexity without losing clarity. You turn configuration-heavy, expert workflows into clear systems.

  • Use AI without sacrificing quality. You've worked out which parts of the job benefit from automation and which need your judgment.

  • Work well in ambiguity. You take rough direction and deliver great work without handholding.

  • Have low ego. Best idea wins. You give and take feedback without making it about you.

Titles are fuzzy. If you're operating at principal level, or you're currently freelancing and curious rather than actively looking, talk to us anyway.

What you will get

  • Full brand ownership, shape how the product feels. Work face-to-face with experienced founders and learn directly from customer insights.

  • Real influence on strategy. In a small team of excellent engineers and operators with high autonomy, you will shape product direction. Best idea wins, regardless of seniority.

  • Fast, ambitious, and fun team. Decisions get made in hours, not weeks. Rapid experimentation is the default.

  • Meaningful equity and competitive salary. You are one of the first to build this, and you share in the upside.

  • A mission that matters. Building intelligent systems for a $200bn industry from Berlin, with AI at the core

Interview process

  • First Call — Intro on what we do with Liza

  • Second Call — Portfolio walkthrough with Jonas

  • Third Call — Get to know our product and culture with our Co-Founder Valentin

  • On-site Day — Meet our full team in our Berlin office and work on a real problem together with us.

title: Financial Auditor / Wirtschaftsprüfer:in (m/f/d)

description_html:
Über uns

Wir sind Cortea, ein Berliner Startup, das Audits mit KI neu denkt. Klassische Prüfungen sind oft manuell, dokumentenlastig und binden wertvolle Expertenzeit während der Bedarf an Audits weiter steigt. Mit unserer KI-gestützten Software und spezialisierten AI Agents automatisieren wir repetitive Arbeit, damit Auditor:innen sich auf das konzentrieren können, was wirklich zählt: fundierte Entscheidungen.

Wir sind mit über 15 Mio. Euro von führenden VCs finanziert, haben ein funktionierendes Produkt im Markt und bereits zahlende Kunden. Jetzt skalieren wir schnell.

Uns treiben First-Principles-Denken, Geschwindigkeit, Vertrauen und Freundlichkeit an. Wir bauen Cortea gemeinsam, direkt vor Ort in unserem Berliner Office.

Die Rolle

Diese Rolle ist für erfahrene Audit-Professionals, die keine Checklisten mehr abarbeiten wollen sondern Systeme entwickeln möchten, die sie überflüssig machen.

Du bringst tiefes Praxiswissen darüber mit, wie Prüfungen wirklich funktionieren, und übersetzt dieses Wissen in strukturierte Logik, die unsere Software skalierbar ausführen kann. Du musst kein:e Entwickler:in sein. Aber du denkst klar in Prozessen, kannst komplexe Standards in konkrete Regeln zerlegen und hast ein starkes Verständnis dafür, wie ein belastbares, qualitativ hochwertiges Prüfungsergebnis aussehen muss.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Audit-Logik entwickeln. Du übersetzt komplexe Anforderungen aus ISA- und IDW-Standards in klare Workflows, denen unsere Software folgen kann. Du definierst die Regeln, das System wendet sie an.

  • Komplexe Dokumente analysierbar machen. Du gestaltest mit, wie unsere Software Verträge und Abschlüsse liest und interpretiert, etwa bei Leasing nach IFRS 16 oder Revenue Recognition. Du definierst, worauf das System achten und wann es Ausnahmen markieren soll.

  • Unabhängigkeit absichern. Du entwickelst Checks, die eine übermäßige Abhängigkeit von automatisierten Ergebnissen verhindern. So stellst du sicher, dass unsere Workflows mit IDW PS 210 vereinbar bleiben und Reviewer jederzeit die Kontrolle über das professionelle Urteil behalten.

  • Dokumentationsqualität verantworten. Du sorgst dafür, dass jedes Systemergebnis sauber in die Prüfungsakte integriert werden kann, im Einklang mit IDW PS 450 und belastbar für Qualitätskontrolle und Peer Review.

  • Cortea extern vertreten. Du nimmst an Branchenveranstaltungen teil, wirkst an Fachpublikationen mit und bringst dich in Gespräche mit Regulatoren zur Rolle von Technologie in der Prüfung ein..

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst mindestens 6 Jahre Erfahrung in der Abschlussprüfung mit, idealerweise aus Big 4 oder einer führenden mittelständischen Prüfungsgesellschaft. Du hast auf Prüfungsleiter-Level gearbeitet und weißt, was Mandatsverantwortung und Haftungsrisiken in der Praxis bedeuten.

  • Du kennst IDW PS, ISA und HGB sicher und kannst Standards in klare, reproduzierbare Prozesse übersetzen.

  • Du denkst in strukturierten Schritten. Du musst nicht programmieren können, aber du kannst Entscheidungsbäume skizzieren, benötigte Inputs definieren und beschreiben, wie ein korrektes Ergebnis aussehen muss.

  • Du willst den Berufsstand mitprägen — nicht nur den nächsten Karriereschritt machen, sondern etwas bauen, das verändert, wie Prüfungen durchgeführt werden.

  • Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch auf muttersprachlichem oder nahezu muttersprachlichem Niveau.

Wie wir arbeiten

  • Nahtlose Umsetzung: Wir arbeiten fokussiert, schnell und mit hohem Anspruch an regulatorische Exzellenz. Sorgfalt ist für uns kein Hindernis, sondern die Grundlage für verlässlichen Fortschritt.

  • Qualität by Design: Wir glauben, dass systemgestützte Konsistenz Reviews entlastet und die Verlässlichkeit des Prüfungsurteils stärkt.

  • Intellektuelle Ehrlichkeit: Wir diskutieren tief, logisch und offen. Wenn ein Feature professionelle Skepsis gefährden könnte, denken wir es neu.

Was wir bieten

  • Impact: Die Chance, die Tools zu bauen, die du dir in der Prüfung immer gewünscht hättest.

  • Wachstum: Der Wechsel aus der klassischen Prüfung in eine wachstumsstarke Rolle an der Schnittstelle von Audit und KI.

  • Vergütung: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und relevante Equity-Beteiligung.

     

Interview-Prozess

  1. Intro call mit Liza (Founders Associate)

  2. Fachliches (Audit-) Interview mit Philipp, Co-Founder.

  3. Strategic & Collaboration Fit mit Valentin, Co-Founder.

  4. On-site Session in Berlin: Eine gemeinsame Session in unserem Berliner Office, in der wir eine „Reviewer-First“-Oberfläche entwickeln mit Fokus auf maximale Transparenz, Nachvollziehbarkeit und professionelle Skepsis.

description_html:
Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

This role sits at the intersection of ML engineering and computational physics, working within our Software Engineering & Digital Twin environments. You'll collaborate closely with optical engineers, laser and fusion physicists, simulation scientists, and systems engineers to embed data-driven intelligence directly into our Digital Twin architecture. You’ll be reducing design risk, shortening development timelines, and unlocking system-level optimization that purely physics-based approaches can't achieve at the speed we need.

You will design, build, and deploy machine learning models that enhance, accelerate, and augment our multiphysics simulation environments across our high-energy laser systems, target injection and tracking system, target manufacturing system, and fusion chamber. This will enable faster design cycles, predictive system optimization, and real-time decision support across our laser, targetry, and fusion programs.

What You'll Do

  • Surrogate & reduced-order modeling: Design and deploy surrogate and reduced-order models (ROMs) that replace or accelerate high-fidelity multiphysics simulations in the Digital Twin environment

  • Physics-informed ML: Develop physics-informed machine learning (PIML) and physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) that embed physical constraints (Maxwell's equations, thermodynamics, fluid dynamics) directly into model architectures

  • ML pipelines: Build and maintain ML pipelines for training, validation, uncertainty quantification (UQ), and continuous model refinement against experimental and simulation data

  • Active learning & Bayesian optimization: Implement active learning and Bayesian optimization workflows to intelligently guide design space exploration and reduce costly simulation runs

  • Digital Twin integration: Integrate trained ML models into the broader Digital Twin framework, interfacing with HPC simulation outputs (COMSOL, ANSYS, custom solvers) and real-time sensor data

  • Anomaly detection: Develop anomaly detection and predictive diagnostics models to monitor system health and identify off-nominal behavior in laser subsystems

  • Autonomous optimization: Apply reinforcement learning and Bayesian control approaches to support autonomous or semi-autonomous optimization of laser operating parameters

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Collaborate with Digital Twin architects, systems engineers, and optical simulation scientists to ensure ML models meet fidelity, latency, and uncertainty requirements

  • Engineering rigor: Establish best practices for model versioning, reproducibility, testing, and documentation in a fast-moving research environment

Who You Are

Must-Haves

  • Master's or PhD in Machine Learning, Computational Physics, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a closely related field

  • Proven experience building, training, and deploying ML models for complex physical systems; strong command of deep learning (PyTorch, TensorFlow/JAX), probabilistic models, and uncertainty quantification

  • Expert-level Python; proficiency in C++ or Fortran a plus; experience with HPC environments (batch schedulers, MPI/OpenMP parallelization)

  • Fluency working with PDE-based simulation outputs, time-series sensor data, and high-dimensional parameter spaces typical of multiphysics environments

  • Hands-on experience with Gaussian processes, neural network surrogates, reduced-order models, or equivalent metamodeling techniques

  • Excellent communication skills — you can explain complex observability concepts clearly to both engineers and executive decision-makers.

Why Dash0

  • Direct access to founders and leadership

title: (Senior) Controller
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at YAZIO
description_html:
HEY THERE

We’re looking for a Senior Controller to join Yazio and take full ownership of our controlling function as we continue to scale. You will bring structure, rigour and depth to our monthly close, accounting operations and internal controls, setting the standard for how controlling operates at Yazio. At our current stage, with around 150 employees, the decisions you make around close architecture and accounting design will have a long-lasting impact and will shape how Finance operates for years to come.

You will own and continuously improve our core accounting and controlling processes, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting and act as the in-house authority on technical accounting topics. Working closely with FP&A, Legal, Operations and external partners, you will support both day-to-day execution and complex accounting questions around new products and transactions.

Let's shape the future of nutrition together and make Yazio the most successful nutrition app worldwide!

This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in Germany, Spain, Portugal, or the U.K.

YOUR MISSION

  • Build, own and drive the monthly close end-to-end, ensuring fast, accurate and well-coordinated financial reporting with Accounting and key stakeholders

  • Review and sign off on accruals, cut-off entries, reconciliations and reporting packages for Management and FP&A

  • Act as the primary go-to for technical accounting questions, supporting new business models, contracts and complex accounting treatments

  • Develop and maintain technical accounting documentation and position papers (for example, revenue recognition, capitalization, leases and other complex topics)

  • Manage and coordinate external partners including accountants, tax advisors and auditors, ensuring strong documentation quality and smooth collaboration

  • Continuously strengthen internal controls by spotting anomalies, following up on open items and improving control effectiveness over time

  • Drive process and system improvements to reduce manual effort, increase close efficiency and build scalable, well-documented workflows

  • Use AI tools to support analysis, variance explanations, audit preparation and accounting research—while ensuring full critical review and accountability for outputs

  • Build a modern, scalable finance function through automation, standardization and continuous improvement

YOUR PROFILE

  • Several years of hands-on experience in Accounting, Controlling or Financial Reporting, ideally in fast-scaling environments with increasing complexity

  • Prior experience leading or coordinating a small accounting team is a plus

  • In-depth knowledge of German HGB; IFRS exposure is a plus

  • Proven ownership of the full monthly close cycle, ensuring accuracy, completeness and high-quality reporting end-to-end

  • Strong internal controls mindset with the ability to proactively identify risks, design controls and continuously improve processes

  • Advanced DATEV skills and confidence working with accounting systems and financial data

  • Comfortable using AI tools to enhance productivity (for example, research, documentation, anomaly detection, reporting support) while applying strong critical judgment on outputs

  • Structured, documentation-first working style with a strong focus on audit readiness and transparency

  • Strong drive for process improvement with a sharp eye for inefficiencies and scalable solutions

  • Proven stakeholder management skills, with experience collaborating with external accountants, tax advisors and auditors

  • Growth mindset and a proactive approach to staying up to date with changes in accounting and tax regulation (e.g., HGB, VAT and IFRS)

WHY US?

  • An exciting product with millions of users in over 150 countries, driven by our mission to transform the world through healthy eating

  • A remote-first setup: work 100% from home, join a co-working space, or work abroad for several weeks per year

  • 30 vacation days to relax and recharge, plus 5 child sick days if your little one needs you

  • A focus-driven culture that values efficiency over long hours - no overtime expectations, and if it happens, you get that time back!

  • A high-impact environment where your work drives real change - short decision-making processes and no micromanagement

  • A team culture where ambition and balance go hand in hand, supported by strong connections - from our fully covered company retreat to team meetups and virtual coffee breaks

  • Tools and support to do your best work: MacBook, monitor, and €1,000 annual learning budget, plus regular feedback and career development

  • A truly international team with English as our company language and a shared commitment to growth and well-being - supported by Sunday Supplements and Nilo Health

DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

At Yazio, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender identity, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, or ability, feels valued and empowered. We celebrate different perspectives and actively encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

READY TO JOIN US?

Excited to take Yazio to the next level and help people worldwide lead healthier lives? We’d love to hear from you! Please send us:

  • Your CV in English

  • A few lines (or a short video if you prefer) about who you are and why you want to work at Yazio

  • Any additional materials that showcase your work (e.g., LinkedIn profile, portfolio)

title: B2B Partnerships & Influencer Marketing Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at YAZIO
description_html:
HALLO

Bist du bereit, die Zukunft von B2B-Partnerschaften im DACH-Markt und darüber hinaus mitzugestalten?

Wir suchen einen Partnerships Manager mit Drive, einem starken Netzwerk und einem tiefen Verständnis für den deutschsprachigen Markt. Du erkennst spannende Kooperationsmöglichkeiten, gehst proaktiv auf potenzielle Partner zu, entwickelst überzeugende Konzepte und verhandelst Partnerschaften, von denen beide Seiten profitieren.

Dabei übernimmst du den gesamten Partnership-Lifecycle – von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme über Verhandlungen und Kampagnen-Launches bis hin zum langfristigen Beziehungsmanagement. Du analysierst, was funktioniert, optimierst kontinuierlich und skalierst erfolgreiche Partnerschaften.

Wenn du gerne mit Menschen arbeitest, Chancen erkennst, bevor andere sie sehen, und aus guten Ideen messbare Ergebnisse machst, könnte das dein nächster Step sein.

Diese Rolle ist zu 100 % remote und offen für Kandidaten mit Wohnsitz in Deutschland, Spanien, Portugal oder Großbritannien.

DEINE MISSION

  • Du baust strategische Partnerschaften in der DACH-Region und auf internationalen Märkten auf, entwickelst sie weiter und skalierst sie – von klassischen B2B-Kooperationen bis hin zu Influencer- und Creator-Partnerschaften.

  • Du identifizierst spannende Partner, sprichst sie proaktiv an und führst sie vom ersten Kontakt über die Verhandlung und das Onboarding bis hin zur langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

  • Du entwickelst kreative Partnerschaftskonzepte und Kampagnen, die zu unserer Marke, unseren Zielen und den jeweiligen Partnern passen.

  • Du verantwortest den gesamten Partnership-Lifecycle – inklusive Verhandlungen, Briefings, Freigabeprozessen, Onboarding und laufendem Beziehungsmanagement.

  • Du bewertest potenzielle Partner anhand von Brand Fit, Zielgruppe, Content-Qualität und relevanten Performance-KPIs.

  • Du entwickelst neue Partnerschaftsmodelle und Kampagnen mit einem besonderen Fokus auf B2B-Partnerschaftensowie Revenue-Share-Kooperationen mit Influencer und Creators.

  • Du misst die Performance deiner Partnerschaften, leitest konkrete Insights ab und optimierst bestehende sowie zukünftige Initiativen kontinuierlich.

  • Du entwickelst skalierbare Prozesse innerhalb des Partnerships-Teams weiter und nutzt Automatisierung und Workflow-Optimierung, um effizienter zu arbeiten.

  • Du behältst auch die operativen Details im Blick – von Vertragsmanagement und Dokumentation bis hin zu Rechnungsstellung und administrativen Prozessen.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit internen Teams und externen Partnern zusammen und stellst sicher, dass Kampagnen und Projekte reibungslos umgesetzt werden.

  • Du repräsentierst das Unternehmen auf Branchenevents, Konferenzen und Networking-Veranstaltungen und baust dein Netzwerk kontinuierlich aus.

  • Je nach Bedarf unterstützt du bei Influencer-Events und Creator-Aktivierungen.

DEIN PROFIL

  • Du bringst mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Partnership-Management mit und kennst den DACH-Markt.

  • Du hast Erfahrung darin, B2B-Partnerschaften aufzubauen, zu verhandeln und langfristig zu entwickeln.

  • Erfahrung mit Influencern, Creators oder Content-Partnern ist ein großes Plus.

  • Du kommunizierst klar, souverän und authentisch und hast ein natürliches Talent dafür, Vertrauen und langfristige Beziehungen aufzubauen.

  • Du hast ein Growth Mindset: Du bist neugierig, ambitioniert und möchtest Dinge nicht nur verwalten, sondern aktiv weiterentwickeln.

title: Account Executive - Mid Market

description_html:
About Peec AI

Peec AI is the analytics platform for AI search. People increasingly discover products and make buying decisions through ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews instead of traditional search, and most brands have no idea where they show up in those answers. Peec gives marketing, SEO, and growth teams the data to see exactly that: how visible their brand is across AI platforms, how they compare to competitors, and where to win.

We are defining this category, and the market is moving with us. Peec is a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, past $10M ARR, with an 80+ person team across our Berlin HQ and our new New York office.

About The Role

We're looking for a Mid-Market Account Executive to build and close pipeline in our larger accounts. Bigger deals, more people in the room, and a real commercial case to make. You'll own it end to end, from the first cold conversation to signature.

You'll build your own pipeline into named accounts, work with the SDR team on coverage, and run the full cycle from there: multi-threading across the account and building the commercial narrative that gets AI search visibility onto a team's budget. We are defining the category, so part of the job is teaching the market what good looks like, not waiting for a buyer who already knows they need this.

What You'll Do

  • Own and run the full sales cycle from first meeting to close across mid-market accounts

  • Multi-thread across marketing, SEO, growth, and procurement stakeholders, and build the business case that gets a deal signed

  • Generate your own pipeline into named accounts, and partner with SDRs and Marketing on targeted outbound and ABM across the patch

  • Keep the CRM and pipeline organised, with a strong handle on forecasting and deal progression

  • Share customer feedback and work with product and engineering to shape what we build

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years in a quota-carrying software sales role, closing mid-market deals end to end

  • A consistent track record of overachievement against quota

  • Experience running multi-stakeholder deals, including building business cases and navigating procurement

  • A builder of your own pipeline: you can point to closed deals that started with your own prospecting, not a lead that landed in your inbox

  • Excellent communication skills and a natural ability for storytelling

  • Comfortable selling in a category that is still being defined, where you shape the buyer's thinking rather than respond to an existing budget line

Bonus Points

  • Experience selling SEO, analytics, or martech software

  • Experience in a high-growth, venture-backed startup environment

  • A track record of selling to marketing, SEO, or growth buyers

  • Repeatedly achieving president's club

What We Offer

  • Exciting and challenging work with real impact and ownership at one of Europe's fastest-growing Series A startups

  • Regular team events and off-sites

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity: everyone at Peec owns a piece of the upside

  • Paid Meal and Uber home when working late

  • The most beautiful office space and work environment in Berlin

Compensation: €110K – €130K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission

description_html:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

You'll join our Ops team right at the intersection of compliance and strategy. Alongside our Fund Compliance Manager, you'll get hands-on with recurring regulatory reporting cycles across a fast-growing portfolio of fund clients, and as you find your footing, you'll get real opportunities to contribute to the process, tooling, and automation work that shapes how the whole team operates. This isn't a role where you'll be handed a task list and left on your own; it's one where good ideas about doing things better are actively wanted.

Your Role

  • Get hands-on with monthly German compliance reporting, Bundesbank reports, AIFMD filings, and FATCA/CRS cycles across a diverse portfolio of fund clients. You'll see how regulation actually works in practice, not just in theory.

  • Collect, review, and verify data and documentation from various stakeholders across our fund clients, spotting inconsistencies, missing pieces, or red flags before they become bigger problems. You'll take ownership of the workstreams that keep this data accurate and our compliance process running smoothly. Think of it as detective work with real regulatory stakes.

  • Beyond the day-to-day, you'll have real opportunities to shape the bigger picture - improving tracking tools, documenting processes, and contributing to automation initiatives that our compliance team is actively driving forward. As you settle into the core workflows, these opportunities naturally grow alongside you. Good ideas here don't just get heard, they get built.


About you

  • Exceptionally detail-oriented and thrives in structured environments

  • Previous experience in banking, legal, or regulatory-related roles is a strong plus, though genuine interest in financial services or fund operations matters just as much if coming from a different background

  • Proactive mindset and strong risk awareness — notices when something's slightly off before it becomes a real problem, and knows when to raise it early

  • Currently enrolled in a related field such as business, law, or finance

  • Structured, detail-oriented working style paired with genuine curiosity about the reasoning behind a process

  • Comfortable owning recurring responsibilities, and just as comfortable questioning and improving them

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and German

  • Comfort with Excel, ideally with some familiarity with tools like Notion, Asana, or Google Sheets

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Make your mark in a mission-driven FinTech startup that values each of its bunchies

  • Be mentored by experienced operators and founders, that take your development seriously

  • Work from an amazing office right in Berlin-Mitte and be part of a welcoming and motivated team

  • Learn fast in a culture that values ownership, creativity, and trust and always strives to empower others

  • Additionally enjoy benefits in mobility, food and learning

  • Take part in a network of people passionate about investment and work closely with the most interesting players in the private market.

  • Benefit from working with a diverse mix of talents, unrivalled energy, and team spirit within a culture of drive and ownership

  • Flexible hours and a hybrid office setup (3 days/week in office)

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

We process personal data in line with applicable laws (including GDPR). See our Privacy Policy for details on your rights and how to reach us.

  • Structured and analytical mindset with strong attention to detail.

  • Excellent communication skills and confidence working with cross-functional teams.

  • Genuine Interest in operations, manufacturing, testing, and continuous process improvement.

  • Fluent in English; German is a plus.

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defence systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defence capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defence: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defence architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defence technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

  • Monthly allowances: €68/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

What It Takes to Make an Impact Here…

  • Proven experience leading or managing software engineering teams.
  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to meaningfully contribute to architecture and technical discussions
  • Experience with modern software development practices, Java-based backend systems, cloud-native architectures, APIs, distributed systems, and CI/CD.

  • Markt-, Wettbewerbs- & Potenzialanalysen: Du führst Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Potenzialanalysen sowie Literatur- und Desk-Recherchen durch, identifizierst neue Wachstumsfelder und leitest daraus strategische Handlungsempfehlungen ab.

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Entrepreneurial Spirit & Eigenmotivation: Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes unternehmerisches Mindset, arbeitest proaktiv, übernimmst Verantwortung, denkst kreativ und bist bereit, für gute Ergebnisse die Extrameile zu gehen.
  • Analytisches & problemlösungsorientiertes Denken: Du kannst komplexe Fragestellungen strukturiert durchdringen, Kennzahlen und Business Cases aufbereiten sowie daraus fundierte Handlungsempfehlungen ableiten.
  • Selbstständige & strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, sorgfältig und organisiert, behältst auch bei Unsicherheit, wechselnden Prioritäten oder mehreren parallelen Themen den Überblick und gehst Herausforderungen lösungsorientiert an.

  • PowerPoint & Excel: Du verfügst über einen sicheren Umgang mit PowerPoint und grundlegende Excel-Kenntnisse zur Analyse und Aufbereitung von Daten.
  • Interesse am Gesundheitsbereich: Du begeisterst dich für den Gesundheitsmarkt, digitale Innovationen und HealthTech und möchtest die Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen aktiv mitgestalten.
  • Praktische Erfahrungen: Idealerweise hast du bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen im Business Development, Venture Development, HealthTech oder einem vergleichbaren dynamischen Umfeld gesammelt.
  • Sprachen: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Unser Angebot

Wir sind ein Unternehmen der Adragos Pharma Gruppe und produzieren an unserem Standort in Leipzig auf modernen Anlagen hochwertige Arzneimittel, Kosmetika und Nahrungsergänzungsprodukte.   • Mitarbeit bei Linienabnahmen und -freigaben


Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung, möglichst Anlagenmechaniker (m/d/d), Mechatroniker (m/w/d), Industriemechaniker (m/w/d), Maschinen- und Anlagenführer (m/w/d)
  • Berufserfahrung im Umgang mit technischen Anlagen, insbesondere Verpackungsanlagen

Wir bieten:

  • Freistellung für den Besuch der begleitenden Unterrichtsveranstaltungen
  • Teilnahme am Sommer- und Weihnachtsfest, Firmenlauf und anderen Veranstaltungen


Deine Aufgaben

Im Rahmen des Praktikums übernimmst du unterschiedliche Aufgaben in den Bereichen Galenik, Herstellung, Qualitätskontrolle und der Qualitätssicherung. Du lernst über die Schnittstelle Qualitätssicherung alle GMP-relevanten Abläufe eines pharmazeutischen Unternehmens kennen und arbeiten aktiv an aktuellen, spannenden Schwerpunktthemen mit. Darüber hinaus erhältst du praktische Einblicke in die Herstellung, Verpackung und Prüfung von Arzneimitteln, Nahrungsergänzungsmittel, Kosmetika und Medizinprodukten. 
Hier kannst du mit deinem Uni-Wissen über analytische Chemie und instrumentelle Analytik z. B. HPLC, UV-VIS punkten und deine Kenntnisse praktisch erweitern. Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Entwicklung und Validierung von analytischen Methoden für den Bereich der Reinigungsvalidierung. In der Qualitätskontrolle führst du selbstständig Rohstoffanalytik nach dem Europäischen Arzneibuch, Fertigproduktanalytik und Stabilitätsprüfungen durch und dokumentierst deine Arbeit im Sinne der GMP. All das selbstständig und bestens von unseren erfahrenen Fachleuten betreut.

Fachliche Anforderungen

  • Abgeschlossenes Pharmaziestudium bzw. abgeschlossenes Zweites Staatsexamen
  • Bereitschaft, sich in qualitätsrelevante Prozesse, pharmazeutische Herstellung und regulatorische Anforderungen einzuarbeiten

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Sorgfalt, Zuverlässigkeit und Termintreue

  • Kommunikationsstärke und Teamfähigkeit
  • Eigenständige, verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise

title: Training Coordinator / Trainer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Derichebourg
description_html:
Your missions

Training

  • Design, prepare, deliver and update theoretical and practical technical training courses in the aeronautical field, according to operational needs.
  • Develop and update training content and teaching materials based on identified needs and the different skill levels of participants.
  • Transfer the technical knowledge and know-how required to perform aeronautical activities.
  • Organise and monitor participants’ progress, assess learning outcomes and propose areas for improvement.
  • Support participants in developing their skills and ensure appropriate follow-up in line with training objectives.

Equipment and workshop management

  • Ensure that the training center and workshops are clean, tidy and in good condition.
  • Check the availability of equipment and consumables required for training activities and place orders if necessary.
  • Immediately report any anomaly, safety issue or shortage of equipment to management.

Health and safety

  • Ensure compliance with health and safety rules in workshops and training areas.
  • Ensure that participants wear the required personal protective equipment.
  • Report any incident or accident to management without delay.

Administrative management and organisation

  • Keep attendance sheets and training follow-up documents up to date.
  • Participate in the preparation and updating of training schedules.
  • Ensure the administrative follow-up required for the proper running of training activities.
  • Secure the smooth implementation of training schedules
  • Prepare a detailed weekly report to be validated with the line manager, and actively participate in the preparation and coordination of the monthly pedagogical committee.


Your profile

  • Technical training in the aeronautical field.
  • At least 3 years of professional experience in the trade and/or experience as a team leader.
  • Good command of technical and teaching practices.
  • Strong organisational skills, accuracy and autonomy.
  • Good interpersonal skills, ability to transfer knowledge and support participants.
  • Strong awareness of safety, quality and cleanliness requirements.
  • Fluency in German, French and English.
  • Availability to travel regularly to Toulouse.


Why join Derichebourg?

  4. Personal Development Support: Experience active promotion of your personal and professional growth in an environment where global perspectives open doors to new horizons.

  8. Corporate Benefits: Unlock exclusive perks and discounts through our participation in the "Corporate Benefits" programme, enhancing your experience in a workplace that celebrates global perspectives.
Join us, where your career journey is complemented by a vibrant and supportive multicultural environment. 

Your success knows no boundaries! 

Apply now and embrace a future full of opportunities on a global scale.

description_html:
Das erwartet Dich bei uns

Im Produktmanagement für unsere professionelle Hair-Care-Marke Urban Alchemy verantwortest Du die Entwicklung, Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung unseres Produktportfolios – von der Idee bis zur Kommerzialisierung. Du analysierst Markt-, Preis- und Wettbewerbsdaten, steuerst Produktentwicklungen und arbeitest eng mit Lieferanten, Herstellern, R&D und internationalen Vertriebspartnern zusammen. Gleichzeitig bringst Du Deine kreativen Ideen in die Produktkommunikation ein und verantwortest gemeinsam mit den relevanten Schnittstellen die Konzeption und Durchführung von Kommunikationskampagnen. Als (Senior) Global Product & Brand Manager berichtest Du direkt an den Vice President Own Brands und führst zwei Direct Reports.

Deine Aufgaben im Detail:

  • Produktmanagement & Portfolio-Strategie: Eigenständige Steuerung des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus - von der Ideenfindung über Formulierungs- und Packaging-Briefings bis zur Markteinführung; Verantwortung für Sortimentsgestaltung, Produktinnovation und Portfolio-Bereinigung
  • Lieferanten- & Produktionsmanagement: Aufbau und Pflege von Lieferantenbeziehungen, eigenständige Koordination von Produktentwicklungsprozessen mit Herstellern sowie Verhandlung von Preiskalkulationen, Mindestabnahmemengen und Produktionskonditionen
  • Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalyse: Durchführung von Research, Markt-, Preis-, Konsumenten-, Trend- und Wettbewerbsanalysen sowie Ableitung konkreter Handlungsempfehlungen für die Produkt- und Sortimentsplanung
  • Budget- & Kostenverantwortung: Eigenständige Steuerung von Projekt- und Produktbudgets inkl. Kosten- und Margenkalkulation sowie Analyse und Optimierung der Produktwirtschaftlichkeit
  • Launch-Steuerung: Eigenverantwortliche Steuerung von Produkteinführungen inkl. Zeitplänen, Stücklisten und Forecasts sowie Abstimmung mit Vertrieb, Supply Chain und internationalen Märkten
  • Testing & Qualitätssicherung: Organisation und Begleitung interner und externer Produkttests zur Validierung von Claims, Wirksamkeit und Qualität sowie Steuerung notwendiger Optimierungen
  • Kommunikation & Kampagnen: Entwicklung kreativer Ideen und Konzepte für die Produktkommunikation sowie Verantwortung für die Konzeption und Durchführung von Kommunikationskampagnen gemeinsam mit den relevanten Schnittstellen
  • Schnittstelle zu Online Marketing & Social Media: Entwicklung von Content-Ideen und fachlichem Input für digitale Kommunikationsmaßnahmen, Erstellung von Storyboards und Briefings sowie enge Zusammenarbeit bei der Umsetzung von Content und Kampagnen


Das bringst Du mit

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium sowie mehrjährige, fundierte Berufserfahrung im Produktmanagement und/oder in der Produktentwicklung, z. B. als (Senior) Product Manager, Product Development Manager, Global Product Manager, Product Innovation Manager, Product Portfolio Manager oder Category Manager, idealerweise im FMCG-, Beauty- oder Professional-Hair-Care-Bereich
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Produktentwicklung, im Lieferanten- und Produktionsmanagement sowie in der Steuerung von Produkten über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus
  • Erfahrung in der Analyse von Preisen, Kosten, Margen, Wettbewerbern und Märkten sowie die Fähigkeit, daraus konkrete Produkt- und Geschäftsentscheidungen abzuleiten
  • Leidenschaft und fundierte Erfahrung im Go-to-Market- und Launch-Management sowie in der Entwicklung und Umsetzung innovativer Produktkonzepte
  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit und Verhandlung mit externen Lieferanten und Herstellern sowie im Management internationaler Partner
  • Idealerweise erste Erfahrung in der Führung und Entwicklung von Teams sowie Freude daran, Mitarbeitende zu motivieren, weiterzuentwickeln und Verantwortung zu übertragen
  • Sehr gute analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten sowie ein hohes Maß an Problemlösungskompetenz und Organisationsstärke
  • Kommunikationsstärke, Verhandlungsgeschick und Überzeugungskraft in der Kommunikation mit internen und externen Stakeholdern
  • Mut zu neuen Ideen, Innovationsgeist und die Durchsetzungskraft, diese erfolgreich in konkrete Produkte, Kommunikationsmaßnahmen und Projekte zu überführen
  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse


Das bieten wir Dir

  • Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Arbeite mit einem kreativen, hochmotivierten Team an Themen am Puls der Zeit - hier gestaltest Du aktiv mit!
  • Internationales Flair & Start-up Vibes: Agiles Arbeiten in einem globalen Umfeld mit echter "Du"-Kultur und flachen Hierarchien
  • Dein Wachstum, Dein Weg: Bringe eigene Ideen ein und nutze Dein persönliches Entwicklungsbudget, um genau das zu lernen, was Dich weiterbringt
  • Kein Tag wie der andere: Vielfältige, spannende Projekte in einem dynamischen, wachstumsstarken Unternehmen
  • Innovationen zum Anfassen: Entdecke angesagte Trendprodukte zum Vorteilspreis - plus jede Menge Freebies
  • Dein Wohlfühl Boost: Profitiere von starken Fitness-Deals, Fahrradleasing, Corporate Benefits und Rabatt bei unseren Partnerfriseuren
  • Late Night im Office? Kein Problem - Dein Abendessen geht auf uns. Einfach bestellen und weitermachen, wenn’s mal länger dauert
  • Deutschlandticket? Sharing is caring: Wir bezuschussen Dein Ticket für maximale Mobilität
  • Work your way: Modern ausgestattetes Office im Herzen von München und Homeoffice inklusive


Dein Weg zu uns

Der Upload Deiner Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Angabe Deines Eintrittstermins und Deiner Gehaltsvorstellungen dauert nur 2 Minuten.

Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, Religion und Weltanschauung, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität. 

Join us!

Wir freuen uns auf Dich!

title: Head of Production (m/f/x)
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Charlesundcharlottegmbh
description_html:
Your tasks

  • You will develop production at C&C, both strategically and operationally: our processes, standards and setups.
  • As Skill Lead, you will take personal and professional responsibility for the production team, support the development of your colleagues and ensure consistently high quality standards.
  • You will take on selected productions yourself as a Producer, making sure that the idea, quality, timing and budget come together.
  • You will conceptualise and own our AI-enabled production system: selecting the right stack and bringing it into production together with our internal AI team. It will be up to you to determine where and when its use makes sense.
  • You will calculate fixed-price productions, protect the margin and decide where the budget can make the greatest difference.
  • You will expand our partner network for high-end productions and ensure that our external partners meet our quality standards.


Your profile

  • You have solid experience in producing social and CTV content and understand the entire process from the initial idea to the final asset.
  • You have experience in the professional leadership and development of production teams and know how to provide direction, feedback and quality standards.
  • You have a clear understanding of how production processes, tools and setups can be developed efficiently and sustainably, as well as solid experience with AI-enabled production and post-production processes.
  • You have a clear point of view on when AI, a hybrid setup or a fully human-made approach makes sense.
  • You work in a structured way, make clear decisions and bring together different internal and external stakeholders.
  • You are based in Berlin and speak German at a native level and English fluently in a professional environment.


Your benefits

  • A team as hot as fresh fries
  • Self-driven teams: trust instead of micro-management
  • Unlimited budget for professional development
  • Period Days Off

title: Senior Programme Manager - EU Projects (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Submariner Network
description_html:
Your mission

For our growing project and service portfolio, we are looking for a senior staff member to:

  • Oversee and manage a portfolio of complex, multi-stakeholder EU-funded projects and service contracts with a focus on high-quality performance and compliance (incl. coordination of activities and tasks of project partners, monitoring of budgets, deliverable preparation, project reporting, etc).
  • Line manage, coordinate and guide staff members within that portfolio of projects and service contracts, including capacity management, performance appraisal and team development.
  • Position SUBMARINER/s.Pro strategically with regard to our different programmes within the field of blue innovations, capacity building and governance especially, but not exclusively under the EU Mission Ocean, EIT Water and DG MARE service contracts. 
  • Lead strategic stakeholder engagement activities within and beyond projects, including government agencies, industry partners, research and non-governmental organizations, to advance our impact across the Baltic and North Sea region and beyond.  
  • Author policy briefs, position papers, topical expert reports, and project deliverables.  
  • Represent the SUBMARINER Network/ s.Pro at workshops, conferences and events, including workshop facilitation and public speaking. 
  • Scout new project acquisition opportunities to advance our strategic objectives, including consortium building, strategic design thinking and proposal writing. 


Your profile

  • Relevant university degree at Master’s level, for example in an environmental / biomarine or social science discipline.
  • At least 7 years proven work experience in EU funding and policy and/or relevant industry sectors.
  • Proven experience in project/service acquisition at coordinator level, and proposal writing for EU projects.
  • Several years of experience in managing people and leading teams.
  • A strong network in the blue economy / sustainability field, and with EU institutions or other relevant stakeholders, is a distinct advantage.
  • Experience and or proven interest in the field of sustainability, environmental or marine topics (blue economy, blue skills and innovation, aquaculture, marine spatial planning or similar).
  • Evidence-based research and science-to-policy translation skills and the ability to produce high-quality reports, briefs and policy recommendations.
  • Skilled communicator with a proven ability to engage partners and donors diplomatically. Experienced in delivering impactful presentations to large audiences and facilitating workshops.
  • Fluent in written and spoken English. Proficiency in German and/or other languages of the Baltic Sea region is an advantage.
  • Good knowledge of MS Office, SharePoint and other collaboration tools.
  • Based in Berlin or willingness to relocate.
  • Able to travel occasionally in Europe to co-host or participate in events.
  • Please note that you must hold the right to live and work in Germany. No visa sponsorship for non-EU nationals can be offered.


Why us?

  • A meaningful job in a very dynamically evolving environment, where you contribute to restoring our Seas and Oceans and promoting a sustainable blue economy.
  • A job in full time (40 hours per week).
  • An interesting multicultural, international and diverse team.
  • Opportunity to travel within Europe for project meetings and events.
  • Possibility to develop your career within the organisation at a fast pace.
  • A beautiful loft office in Berlin.
  • Up to three home office days per week; flexible working hours and 28 days of holiday annually.
  • Regular overall team retreats to promote internal knowledge transfer, generate shared ideas and strengthen the working atmosphere.

title: Technical Product Owner – C++ SDK & ImFusion Suite

description_html:
Your mission

We are looking for an experienced Technical Product Owner to take ownership of our C++ SDK, which forms the core of our software platform and serves as the foundation for the majority of our engineering work, products, and customer projects.

You will shape the product direction, roadmap, priorities, and release process while working closely with software engineers, our Lead Architect, product teams, and business stakeholders.

The role is designed to grow into functional and people leadership responsibility for engineers working on the C++ SDK and ImFusion Suite.


Your responsibilities

  • Own and continuously develop product vision, roadmap, backlog, and prioritization for our C++ SDK & ImFusion Suite

  • Align C++ SDK and ImFusion Suite roadmap with our wider company and platform strategy 

  • Bring together requirements from customers, internal users, product teams, engineering, and management and translate them into clear priorities.

  • Coordinate development activities and releases across teams and components, ensuring that individual efforts contribute to a coherent product.

  • Manage timelines, dependencies, risks, capacity, and technical trade-offs.

  • Balance short-term delivery needs with technical quality and the long-term development of the product.

  • Drive resource planning, support team growth, and gradually take on functional and people leadership.


Who you are

  • You are a systems thinker who can understand a complex technical ecosystem, connect the individual pieces, and maintain sight of the bigger picture.

  • You combine genuine technical curiosity with a strong product mindset and a desire to create impact beyond implementation.

  • You bring clarity and structure to ambiguous situations without oversimplifying technical complexity.

  • You listen to different perspectives but are comfortable challenging assumptions, setting boundaries, and saying no when necessary—regardless of seniority or role.

  • You communicate confidently with engineers, scientists, product teams, customers, and management and build trust across these groups.

  • You take ownership, follow through, and proactively address risks and obstacles.

  • You lead through trust, constructive feedback, sound judgement, and a genuine interest in helping others grow.


Your profile

  • Several years of experience as a software engineer, giving you a solid understanding of programming and software development.

  • Subsequent experience owning or coordinating a technically complex software product, platform, or large-scale engineering initiative.

  • Experience developing roadmaps, managing requirements, setting priorities, and coordinating delivery across multiple teams and stakeholders.

  • Experience coordinating, mentoring, or enabling software engineers; previous formal leadership experience is a plus. 

  • A strong understanding of APIs, software architecture, testing, technical debt, maintainability, versioning, and backwards compatibility.

  • Experience with capacity and resource planning, including translating roadmap needs into staffing or hiring requirements.

  • Hands-on experience adapting SDK requirements, architecture, and product roadmaps to advances in AI.

Nice to have

  • Experience with C++ development or ownership of a C++-based product or platform.

  • Experience with developer-facing products or SDKs.

  • A background in medical imaging, computer vision, or another technically complex software domain.

  • Ideally, you are based in Munich or the surrounding area and enjoy working regularly from our Munich office, allowing you to connect with key stakeholders in person.


Why us?

  • Shape foundational technologies used across our products and customer projects.

  • Work closely with experienced engineers, architects, and product teams.

  • Take on significant ownership and grow into functional and people leadership.

  • Work on challenging software at the intersection of medical imaging, computer vision, and AI.

  • Benefit from flexible working arrangements and a collaborative environment.

The stated salary range includes a discretionary, performance-based bonus.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at exmox
description_html:
Your Mission

This is a company built for growth.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. You'll work on real systems at a big scale, building high-performing consumer products used by millions. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins. 

We're rapidly scaling one of the most exciting innovations in mobile gaming: a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences. Our products are data-driven by design, powered by event-driven architectures, complex business logic, and quick feedback loops, with decisions informed by data and experimentation, not gut feeling.

As Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x), this role isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger technical and business picture, working closely with Engineering, including how we use AI to move faster and cut down on repetitive work, and turning strategy into precise, technically grounded product decisions that create real value. Every change you ship affects millions of users, and that responsibility is what makes working at exmox exciting.

If you're energized by fast-moving markets, complex technical systems, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Own:

  • Technical product strategy & vision Together with Engineering leads, you shape the product vision, strategy, and roadmap with a clear understanding of technical constraints and opportunities. You define goals and success metrics, and continuously evolve product direction based on system capabilities, technical debt, and business priorities.

  • Discovery, scoping & prioritization You gather and balance inputs from engineering, user research, data, and stakeholders to deeply understand problems, including their technical complexity. You write detailed, unambiguous requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineers can act on immediately.

  • Agile ownership & delivery You own the product backlog end-to-end: grooming, refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization. You actively participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews, and sprint ceremonies, ensuring the team always has well-defined, ready-to-build work.

  • Technical stakeholder alignment You translate business needs into precise engineering requirements, and translate technical realities back into language stakeholders understand. You work closely with Engineering, UI/UX, Data, Marketing, and Operations to ensure alignment across the full product lifecycle.

  • Experimentation & continuous improvement You leverage A/B testing, analytics, and system monitoring to validate ideas, measure outcomes, and drive ongoing product and technical improvements. You understand data pipelines and instrumentation well enough to define the right metrics from the ground up.


What You Bring

  • Technical Product Manager experience Strong experience as a Technical Product Manager building digital products, ideally in mobile gaming, ad-tech, e-commerce, or online marketing. You've worked closely with engineering teams and are comfortable in technical conversations.

  • Engineering fluency You don't need to code, but you can read and discuss API contracts, system architectures, database schemas, and technical trade-offs. Engineers see you as a peer, not just a requirements writer.

  • Agile ownership You have deep hands-on experience owning a product backlog: writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, running sprint ceremonies, and continuously improving team throughput and focus.

  • Data-driven product decisions Solid experience using quantitative data, A/B testing, funnel analysis, and product analytics tools to guide decisions. You understand how data is collected, structured, and interpreted, and can define instrumentation requirements yourself.

  • High-scale product teams At least 4 years of experience working with cross-functional engineering and product teams on high-scale digital products with millions of users.

  • Discovery & problem solving Strong analytical and structured thinking skills. You can break down complex technical and product problems, identify root causes, and drive toward clear, testable solutions.

  • Ownership mindset You unblock teams, remove ambiguity, and take accountability for outcomes, not just outputs. You're persistent, solution-oriented, and comfortable making calls with incomplete information.

  • Clear communicator across technical and non-technical audiences Outstanding at adapting communication style: precise and detailed with engineers, strategic and impact-focused with leadership and business stakeholders.

  • Structured & organized Able to manage multiple workstreams, balance competing priorities, and deliver against realistic timelines without losing sight of the bigger picture


How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.

  • Value-creation strategy: Develop a structured value creation plan to prioritize high impact growth levers for partners, while owning the full sales pipeline from prospecting and negotiating commercials to bringing campaigns live and scaling them.
  • Reactivation & Account Optimization: Systematically diagnose why paused or underperforming accounts are missing their full potential. You’ll build and execute tailored commercial and technical recovery plans collaborating with internal teams and clients to close performance gaps and bring advertisers back to scale.
  • New Vertical Launches: Take new verticals from idea to first revenue, mapping demand, understanding geo, payment and legal framework, and landing the first reference partners.
  • RevOps & Enablement: Run "special" projects that make the commercial org faster, from automating manual workflows to codifying best practices and playbooks for the Account Management team.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Work closely with Product, Marketing, Legal & Compliance, Finance and Account Management to unblock deals, shape integrations and hand over accounts cleanly once they're live.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Build the business case yourself, model deal economics i.e. CPI, ROAS, revenue share, LTV and use performance data to structure partnerships that work for the partner and for exmox.
  • Product Voice & Advocacy: Translate what you hear in the market into prioritized, revenue-driving requirements for the roadmap.


What You Bring

  • Relevant Experience: 7+ years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, or B2B sales, with a proven history of personally initiating and closing high-impact deals.
  • "Swiss Army Knife" Profile: You're a builder and a generalist. You're as comfortable opening a new market as you are documenting a process, and you don't wait for someone to define the scope for you.
  • Commercial Hunter Mentality: A "sales-driven" personality obsessed with moving the needle; you are constantly asking "how can we double these numbers?" to drive exponential growth.
  • Data-Driven Mindset: Highly analytical, comfortable in spreadsheets and BI tools, able to turn raw performance data into a commercial argument and a clear next step.
  • Process & Automation Instinct: You notice repetitive work and remove it. Hands-on experience with CRM, no-code automation or AI tooling to scale your own output and the team's is a strong plus.
  • Communication Skills: Full professional fluency in English with the interpersonal "spine" to challenge partners' assumptions and stand your ground during tough negotiations.
  • Ambitious & Goal-Oriented: A self-starter with high "eagerness" who doesn't just meet targets but proactively seeks ways to exceed them.
  • Nice to have: Management consulting background (e.g., Bain, BCG, McKinsey) combined with business development for a tech scale up.
  • Nice to have: Sales experience within adtech, gaming, rewarded user acquisition industry.


How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.

  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.

  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. “Not my job” isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.

  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.

  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

description_html:
Short title

Build brand communities on social media


Introduction

You don't just manage social media, you shape how brands show up on it. As a Senior Social Media Manager at Pulse Advertising, you lead multi-platform strategies for global brand accounts, drive creative direction, and set the standard for platform-native excellence. You know what's about to peak on TikTok before it peaks, and you're as strong creatively as you are strategically, ideating concepts in a client workshop and owning their execution the next day. You're a trusted senior partner to clients and a go-to voice internally, someone who takes ownership of outcomes, not just outputs. If you're ready to lead at the intersection of strategy, creativity, and impact, this is your next chapter.


Your tasks

  • You own TikTok-first content strategies for key global brand accounts, defining platform-native formats, content pillars, and creative direction that drive measurable engagement and business results

  • You lead content planning and execution across TikTok, Reels, Stories, and complementary formats, ensuring every channel feels native, intentional, and on-brand

  • You manage social media across multiple brands within a single parent account, adapting global content frameworks for regional markets with a particular focus on DACH

  • You act as a senior client partner, steering projects from briefing to delivery, proactively shaping agendas and challenging briefs that don't align with platform or audience reality

  • You track, synthesise, and present performance data, translating complex analytics into sharp client-ready insights and actionable recommendations

  • You mentor junior and mid-level team members and contribute to pitches and new business proposals, bringing your platform expertise to grow both the team and the account base


Your skills

  • You bring 5+ years of hands-on experience in social media management with a clear TikTok focus, including proven results across global or multi-market brand accounts- ideally in consumer goods, home appliances, or lifestyle hardware

  • You think in TikTok: trend cycles, FYP mechanics, algorithm behaviour, and the instinct to know what feels native versus what kills engagement

  • You are comfortable operating within multi-brand account structures and familiar with global-to-local content models, managing competing brand identities across markets without losing quality or speed

  • You are a hands-on creative with the ability to concept campaign ideas and translate them into platform-native formats that resonate with audiences and impress clients

  • You are experienced with Canva, video editing tools, and social analytics platforms and actively use AI tooling to scale your work

  • You are confident leading senior client relationships, communicating platform logic clearly, managing expectations and influencing decisions at stakeholder level.

  • You are fluent in both German and English 


Our Benefits

  • Time to pack your bags for Paris, London, Milan, Hamburg or Berlin: you’re welcome to work abroad from any of our office locations

  • We love to see you grow: our careers coach is on hand for one-to-one coaching sessions and team workshops

  • We work hard and play hard, bringing our global team together to collaborate, learn from one another and celebrate our successes

  • Don’t fancy the office today? Our hybrid remote policy lets you work from home two days a week

  • Keep your commute to a minimum: you’ll find all our offices right in the city centre

  • For motivational high-paws and comforting cuddles, your four-legged friend is absolutely welcome at our offices

title: Director, Site Reliability Engineering
